# Cast

**CAPTAIN VEX** — Master of the Marrow, 40s. Theatrical, vain, deflecting; charming when cornered. *[89 lines in ending, vex.]*

**CAPTAIN MORDANT** — Captain of the Grey Lantern. Ancient, courteous, territorial. *[28 lines in ending, mordant.]*

**ELIAS FENN** — Fenn's father, 50s. Cheerful about catastrophe; apologises for the wrong things. *[47 lines in elias.]*

**FENN** — Cartographer's apprentice, 23. Precise, dry, maps everything; braver than he sounds. *[The player: every choice and every verb line.]*

**HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK** — Harbourmaster. Pompous, guilty, kind. *[26 lines in bramwick.]*

**MARTA** — Tavern keeper. Warm, sharp, keeps the island's stories. *[31 lines in marta.]*

**QUILL** — Navigator, 22. Blunt, quick, competitive; tender when cornered. *[51 lines in quill.]*

**OLD ROOK** — Old navigator; the one man who came back. Wry, scared sober. *[24 lines in rook.]*

**NELL** — Market stallholder. Brisk, appraising. *[12 lines in nell.]*

**TAM** — A boy in Upper Town, Hobb's nephew. Counting, blunt, brave. *[11 lines in tam.]*

**OLD ONN** — Island elder. Dry, watchful. *[12 lines in onn.]*

**DORRIT** — Cook, 60s. Fussy, superstitious. *[34 lines in dorrit.]*

**HOBB** — Carpenter and bosun, 40s. Few words, big feelings. *[39 lines in hobb.]*

**PIKE** — Wrecker boss. Jobsworth crook. *[24 lines in pike.]*

**TAM HOBB** — Able seaman, Hobb's brother. Tired, dutiful. *[No spoken lines.]*

## Act I — Opening

*[Fenn carries: Elias's compass]* <sub>acts.adv:8</sub>

*[starts in Dreadwater Harbour]*

> **CAPTION**: Dreadwater Isle. Three months since my father sailed into the fog. Half the harbour is empty, and the other half won't meet my eye. <sub>acts.adv:9</sub>

## Dreadwater Harbour

*[room* `dock`*]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act I, if dock_landed = false]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:34</sub>
  - *[sets dock_landed]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:35</sub>

  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Dreadwater. Three months since my father sailed, and the harbour has gone quiet. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:37</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: One ship is tied up. The other berths are empty, and the lamps are lit for nobody. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:38</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: A lamp burns in the harbourmaster's house. It is the only welcome in sight. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:39</sub>

**the Marrow** `ship` <sub>rooms/dock.adv:42</sub>

- **Look at:** The Marrow. Her sails are still bent, and her deck is scrubbed. She is the only ship here with any gear aloft. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:45</sub>
- **Talk to:** I call up to the deck. Nobody answers. The harbour has taught everyone not to shout at ships. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:46</sub>
- **Use:** I would need a captain first. That seems to be the trouble everywhere on this island. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:49</sub>
- **Open:** I am not opening a ship. Ships open themselves, usually at the worst moment. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:47</sub>
- **Pick up:** She is a little big for my satchel. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:48</sub>
- *When* *[if vex_deal]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:50</sub>

  - **Talk to:** A man on deck raises a hand, then remembers he is not supposed to be friendly. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:52</sub>
- *When* *[if met_vex]* *— called “the Marrow, Vex's ship”* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:53</sub>
  - **Look at:** The Marrow. Vex's ship, and the only way off this island that is still afloat. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:55</sub>

**the Salty Keel** `tavern_door` <sub>rooms/dock.adv:57</sub>

- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Salty Keel]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:60</sub>
- **Open:** I push the door. The room goes quiet in the way a room does when it knows me. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:62</sub>

- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Harbourmaster's House]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:67</sub>
- **Open:** I go in. Bramwick has run this harbour for thirty years, and he will know what to say. <sub>rooms/dock.adv:69</sub>

- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Wreckers' Lane]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:74</sub>

**the road up to town** `road` <sub>rooms/dock.adv:78</sub>

- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Upper Town]* <sub>rooms/dock.adv:81</sub>

*[room* `tavern`*]* <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:1</sub>

**Marta** `marta` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:31</sub>

- **Look at:** Marta, behind the bar. She's been wiping the same glass since I walked in. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:34</sub>

- **Give:** She only takes things worth trading. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:37</sub>

**old sailor** `rook` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:42</sub>

- **Look at:** An old man at a corner table. His mug is full and his eyes aren't. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:45</sub>
- **Talk to:** He looks up before I speak. He's been waiting. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:46</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [rook](#dlg-rook) *— below]* <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:47</sub>
- **Give:** He waves it away without looking at it. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:48</sub>
- *When* *[if met_rook]* *— called “Old Rook”* <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:49</sub>
  - **Look at:** Rook at his table by the door. He's put the mug down. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:51</sub>

**Dorrit** `dorrit` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:53</sub>

- **Look at:** Dorrit, in his apron, holding a spoon like a small weapon. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:56</sub>
- **Talk to:** I ask about the stores. He turns before I finish. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:57</sub>
  - *[sets met_dorrit]* *[→ conversation* [dorrit](#dlg-dorrit) *— below]* <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:58</sub>
- **Give:** He looks at my hands. 'I've no use for it. I've no use for any of it.' <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:60</sub>
- *When* *[if met_dorrit]* <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:61</sub>
  - **Look at:** Dorrit, still furious and still cooking. The spoon has not been put down. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:62</sub>

**the bar** `bar` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:64</sub>

- **Look at:** The bar. It's been polished by elbows and one very determined mop. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:67</sub>
- **Use:** I'd need money, and Marta's permission. I've neither. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:68</sub>
- **Open:** It's a bar, not a crate. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:69</sub>

**the regulars** `crowd` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:71</sub>

- **Look at:** Four regulars at the long table. They've been drinking to the Marrow. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:74</sub>
- **Talk to:** I ask about the fog. The table goes quiet at once. It's a local custom. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:75</sub>
- **Give:** They've no use for a compass and no manners for a gift. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:76</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:rook.story]* <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:77</sub>
  - **Look at:** The regulars have heard Rook talking. They're pretending they haven't. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:78</sub>

**the door down to the harbour** `door_out` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:82</sub>

- **Look at:** The door down to the harbour. The wind smells of salt and something colder. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:86</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Dreadwater Harbour]* <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:85</sub>

**the window** `window` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:88</sub>

- **Look at:** The window looks out on the harbour. There's one lamp and a lot of dark. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:91</sub>
- **Use:** It doesn't open. Marta says the view is better with the glass in. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:92</sub>

**the nets** `nets` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:94</sub>

- **Look at:** Nets hung from the beams, dry and stiff with salt. Nobody has fished them in years. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:97</sub>
- **Use:** I'd need a boat and a reason. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:98</sub>
- **Pull:** The net is tied off. Everything in this room is tied off. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:99</sub>

**the bottle shelf** `bottles` <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:101</sub>

- **Look at:** Bottles, sorted by colour and trouble. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:104</sub>
- **Use:** I'd have to reach over the bar. Marta is watching. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:105</sub>

**Combinations here**

- **Use Elias's compass on old sailor:** He turns it over once. 'Your father's. It still points at the fog.' <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:108</sub>
- **Use Elias's compass on Marta:** She looks at it and gives it back. 'Keep it. It's the only thing of his you have.' <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:110</sub>
- **Use Elias's compass on Dorrit:** She squints at it. 'Your father's? Then keep it dry.' <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:112</sub>
- **Use Elias's chart on Marta:** *[if has Elias's chart]* She reads it upside down and doesn't ask. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:114</sub>
- **Use Elias's chart on old sailor:** *[if has Elias's chart]* He knows it. He doesn't want to touch it. <sub>rooms/tavern.adv:116</sub>

<a id="dlg-marta-island"></a>`island` **MARTA**: Half the harbour is empty. The other half is related, and scared. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:41</sub>
- *→ continues at* [island2](#dlg-marta-island2)

<a id="dlg-marta-island2"></a>`island2` **MARTA**: Six ships gone in three years. Five came back empty. Your father's never came back at all. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:43</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Empty how? <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:44</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [empty](#dlg-marta-empty)
- **2.** **FENN**: What does Vex say? <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:45</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [vex](#dlg-marta-vex)
- **3.** **FENN**: Who is Dorrit? <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:46</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [dorrit](#dlg-marta-dorrit) *(above)*
- **4.** **FENN**: That's enough. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:47</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-marta-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-marta-empty"></a>`empty` **MARTA**: Sails set, wheel tied off, not a soul aboard. That's not weather. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:48</sub>
- *→ continues at* [island2](#dlg-marta-island2) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-marta-vex"></a>`vex` **MARTA**: Captain Vex. He owns the Marrow, and most of the salvage on this coast. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:50</sub>
- *→ continues at* [vex2](#dlg-marta-vex2)

<a id="dlg-marta-vex2"></a>`vex2` **MARTA**: The island blames him for the missing ships. He lets them. Fear keeps his prices high. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:52</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where do I find him? <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:53</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [vex_where](#dlg-marta-vex_where) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Will he sail? <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:54</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [vex_will](#dlg-marta-vex_will)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'll talk to him. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:55</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-marta-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-marta-vex_will"></a>`vex_will` **MARTA**: Not into the fog. Not for money. Not for me. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:56</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-marta-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-marta-rule"></a>`rule` **MARTA**: Rook told you that? Then keep your bell quiet and your mouth shut. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:80</sub>
- *→ continues at* [rule2](#dlg-marta-rule2)

<a id="dlg-marta-rule2"></a>`rule2` **MARTA**: I've buried enough people who didn't. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:82</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-marta-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-marta-chart"></a>`chart` **MARTA**: Then you've got more than most. Don't let Vex see it. He'll want half. <sub>dialogue/marta.adv:84</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-marta-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook"></a>
### Conversation: rook (Old Rook)

*[source:* `dialogue rook`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-rook-root"></a>`root` **OLD ROOK**: Elias Fenn's boy. I'd know those eyes anywhere. Don't look pleased about it. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:2</sub>
- *[sets met_rook]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:3</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You knew my father. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [knew](#dlg-rook-knew)
- **2.** **FENN**: You're the one who came back. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [came_back](#dlg-rook-came_back)
- **3.** **FENN**: I need to know about the fog. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fog](#dlg-rook-fog)
- **4.** **FENN**: I found your old log. *[if weather_works_store and rook_story = false]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:7</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [log](#dlg-rook-log)
- **5.** **FENN**: Tell me the rule again. *[if rook_story]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:8</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [after](#dlg-rook-after)
- **6.** **FENN**: I'll leave you to your drink. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:9</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye)

<a id="dlg-rook-knew"></a>`knew` **OLD ROOK**: I navigated for him for eleven years. Best captain on the Shroud run. Worst singer. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:10</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: He sailed into the fog three months ago. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:11</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [lost](#dlg-rook-lost)
- **2.** **FENN**: You were with him when he went? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:12</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [with_him](#dlg-rook-with_him)

<a id="dlg-rook-lost"></a>`lost` **OLD ROOK**: I heard. The Arcadia went in at dusk with a full crew. Nobody came out. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:13</sub>
- *→ continues at* [lost2](#dlg-rook-lost2)

<a id="dlg-rook-lost2"></a>`lost2` **OLD ROOK**: I wasn't aboard that night. I was here, drinking. That's the part I can't fix. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:15</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where were you? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:16</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [with_him](#dlg-rook-with_him)
- **2.** **FENN**: What took her? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fog](#dlg-rook-fog)

<a id="dlg-rook-with_him"></a>`with_him` **OLD ROOK**: I shipped on the Kestrel after your father retired me. She went into the fog. I came back. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:18</sub>
- *→ continues at* [with_him2](#dlg-rook-with_him2)

<a id="dlg-rook-with_him2"></a>`with_him2` **OLD ROOK**: I don't remember how. I remember the bell. That's all I'll say sober. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:20</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The bell? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:21</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fog](#dlg-rook-fog)
- **2.** **FENN**: Then say it drunk. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:22</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [drunk](#dlg-rook-drunk)

<a id="dlg-rook-fog"></a>`fog` **OLD ROOK**: The fog takes ships. That's public knowledge. The rest is in my log. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:30</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where's your log? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:31</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [book](#dlg-rook-book)
- **2.** **FENN**: Tell me the rest. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:32</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [rest](#dlg-rook-rest)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'll find my own answers. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:33</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye)

<a id="dlg-rook-book"></a>`book` **OLD ROOK**: Up at the light. The keeper keeps the old logs. Mine's in the store with my name on it. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:36</sub>
- *[chart:* Rook's old log is in the keeper's store at the lighthouse. The last page is a list of names.*]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:37</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll fetch it. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:38</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [promise](#dlg-rook-promise)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why should I trust a drunk? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:39</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [trust](#dlg-rook-trust)

<a id="dlg-rook-promise"></a>`promise` **OLD ROOK**: Then go. I'll be here. I'm always here. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:40</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye)

<a id="dlg-rook-bye"></a>`bye` **OLD ROOK**: Go on. And come back. I'd like to be wrong about something. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:69</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-rook-trust"></a>`trust` **OLD ROOK**: You shouldn't. But the log doesn't lie, and I can't say the same for myself. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:42</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook-rest"></a>`rest` **OLD ROOK**: Not sober. I've been sober once since the Kestrel. It didn't last the night. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:34</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook-drunk"></a>`drunk` **OLD ROOK**: No. I've tried. The drink makes it louder. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:23</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook-came_back"></a>`came_back` **OLD ROOK**: One man came back. That's me. It's not a boast. It's a warning. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:25</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What happened out there? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:26</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fog](#dlg-rook-fog) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Why do you stay here? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:27</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [stay](#dlg-rook-stay)

<a id="dlg-rook-stay"></a>`stay` **OLD ROOK**: The sea's done with me. The bar isn't. That's not the same as safe. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:28</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook-log"></a>`log` **OLD ROOK**: You found it. Then you read the part about the bell. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:44</sub>
- *→ continues at* [log2](#dlg-rook-log2)

<a id="dlg-rook-log2"></a>`log2` **OLD ROOK**: It rang with no hand on the rope. The crew went to the rail to look. I didn't. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:46</sub>
- *→ continues at* [rule](#dlg-rook-rule)

<a id="dlg-rook-rule"></a>`rule` **OLD ROOK**: The thing in the fog hunts by sound. Keep quiet, and it loses you for a while. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:48</sub>
- *[sets rule_sound]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:49</sub>
- *[chart:* Rook: the Grey Lantern hunts by sound. Silence the bell and it loses you for a while.*]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:50</sub>
- *→ continues at* [chart](#dlg-rook-chart)

<a id="dlg-rook-chart"></a>`chart` **OLD ROOK**: There's a chart folded in the back. Your father's hand. He drew the fog's edge before he went in. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:52</sub>
- *[Fenn receives: Elias's chart]* *[sets rook_story]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:53</sub>
- *[chart:* Rook gave me my father's chart of the fog's edge. It was folded in the back of his old log.*]* <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:55</sub>
- *→ continues at* [story](#dlg-rook-story)

<a id="dlg-rook-story"></a>`story` **OLD ROOK**: He gave it to me the night before he sailed. I told him not to go. He laughed. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:57</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Thank you, Rook. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:58</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [thanks](#dlg-rook-thanks)
- **2.** **FENN**: What else do you remember? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:59</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [more](#dlg-rook-more)
- **3.** **FENN**: Why didn't you go with him? <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:60</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why_not](#dlg-rook-why_not)

<a id="dlg-rook-thanks"></a>`thanks` **OLD ROOK**: Go on. Be a better navigator than me. The bar is low and I'm under it. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:65</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook-more"></a>`more` **OLD ROOK**: The crew. My crew. They're still out there. I hear the bell some nights. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:61</sub>
- *→ continues at* [thanks](#dlg-rook-thanks) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook-why_not"></a>`why_not` **OLD ROOK**: I was afraid. I'm still afraid. It's the only thing I've kept up. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:63</sub>
- *→ continues at* [thanks](#dlg-rook-thanks) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-rook-after"></a>`after` **OLD ROOK**: Keep the bell quiet. Keep your head down. That's all I know. <sub>dialogue/rook.adv:67</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-rook-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit"></a>
### Conversation: dorrit (Dorrit)

*[source:* `dialogue dorrit`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-dorrit-root"></a>`root` **DORRIT**: Well? I've no time to waste, and neither has the stew. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:2</sub>
- *[sets met_dorrit]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:3</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You're Dorrit, the cook? *[if met_dorrit = false]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [cook](#dlg-dorrit-cook)
- **2.** **FENN**: Marta says you're blamed. *[if dorrit_cleared = false]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [blamed](#dlg-dorrit-blamed)
- **3.** **FENN**: Pike gave up the rudder. You're clear. *[if rudder_back and seen:dorrit.confess and dorrit_cleared = false]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [clear2](#dlg-dorrit-clear2)
- **4.** **FENN**: What's missing? *[if dorrit_cleared = false]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:7</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [stores](#dlg-dorrit-stores)
- **5.** **FENN**: You're cleared. Come aboard. *[if dorrit_cleared]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:8</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [cleared](#dlg-dorrit-cleared)
- **6.** **FENN**: Nothing. I'm sorry. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:9</sub>
  - *[ends]*
- **7.** **FENN**: What's in the pot? *[Act II only]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:10</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [galley](#dlg-dorrit-galley)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-cook"></a>`cook` **DORRIT**: The cook. The one the island is blaming for a thief's work. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:12</sub>
- *→ continues at* [blamed](#dlg-dorrit-blamed)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-blamed"></a>`blamed` **DORRIT**: Blamed. Forty years cooking for this island, and now I'm a thief. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:15</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Why you? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:16</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why](#dlg-dorrit-why)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's missing? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [stores](#dlg-dorrit-stores)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-why"></a>`why` **DORRIT**: The key is on my belt. The lock is older than I am. So it's my fault. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:19</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Who else could get in? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:20</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [key](#dlg-dorrit-key)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll find the truth. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:21</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-key"></a>`key` **DORRIT**: The lane door has a loose bolt. Half the island knows it. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:23</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What's missing? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:24</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [stores](#dlg-dorrit-stores)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll look around. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:25</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-stores"></a>`stores` **DORRIT**: Six crates. Salt, flour, dried fish. The good tea. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:27</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Who would take them? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:28</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [who](#dlg-dorrit-who)
- **2.** **FENN**: What does the fog take? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:29</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fog](#dlg-dorrit-fog)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'll look around. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:30</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-who"></a>`who` **DORRIT**: Anyone hungry. That's the trouble with blaming the cook. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:32</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-fog"></a>`fog` **DORRIT**: The fog takes ships, not tea. I've watched it from the hill. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:35</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-clear2"></a>`clear2` **DORRIT**: Pike's man talked? Then say it where the island can hear. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:38</sub>
- *[sets dorrit_cleared]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:39</sub>
- *→ continues at* [thanks](#dlg-dorrit-thanks)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-thanks"></a>`thanks` **DORRIT**: I'm cleared, then. Once the island hears it. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:42</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll tell them. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:43</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [join](#dlg-dorrit-join)
- **2.** **FENN**: What about the man in the shed? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:44</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wen](#dlg-dorrit-wen)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-join"></a>`join` **DORRIT**: Then I'm coming with you. Somebody has to feed that crew. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:49</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-wen"></a>`wen` **DORRIT**: He can sleep in my kitchen till the Marrow sails. Pike won't look there. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:46</sub>
- *→ continues at* [join](#dlg-dorrit-join) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-cleared"></a>`cleared` **DORRIT**: Cleared. I've packed my spoons. All forty of them. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:52</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Forty spoons? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:53</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [spoons](#dlg-dorrit-spoons)
- **2.** **FENN**: What about the man in the shed? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:54</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wen2](#dlg-dorrit-wen2)
- **3.** **FENN**: Welcome aboard. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:55</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-spoons"></a>`spoons` **DORRIT**: One for each year I've cooked here. I'm not leaving them for Pike. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:57</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-wen2"></a>`wen2` **DORRIT**: He can sleep in my kitchen till the Marrow sails. Pike won't look there. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:60</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-galley"></a>`galley` **DORRIT**: Mind the pot. It has been on since the anchor came up. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:102</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What's in it? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:103</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [pot](#dlg-dorrit-pot)
- **2.** **FENN**: You've seen the hold. *[if salvage_seen]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:104</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [hold2](#dlg-dorrit-hold2)
- **3.** **FENN**: Why did you come aboard? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:105</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why3](#dlg-dorrit-why3)
- **4.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:106</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-pot"></a>`pot` **DORRIT**: Salt beef, and a potato that has seen better days. Don't tell the potato. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:108</sub>
- *→ continues at* [galley2](#dlg-dorrit-galley2)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-galley2"></a>`galley2` **FENN (V.O.)**: He stirs. He tastes. He adds salt with the look of a man settling a debt. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:111</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What's in it? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:112</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [pot](#dlg-dorrit-pot) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: You've seen the hold. *[if salvage_seen]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:113</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [hold2](#dlg-dorrit-hold2)
- **3.** **FENN**: Why did you come aboard? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:114</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why3](#dlg-dorrit-why3)
- **4.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:115</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-hold2"></a>`hold2` **DORRIT**: I have cooked beside that pile for a day and never once looked at the names. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:117</sub>
- *→ continues at* [hold3](#dlg-dorrit-hold3)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-hold3"></a>`hold3` **DORRIT**: Marta tells a story about the Cormorant. She tells it on the cold nights. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:120</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Tell me the story. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:121</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [cormorant](#dlg-dorrit-cormorant)
- **2.** **FENN**: Vex never said where it came from. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:122</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [never](#dlg-dorrit-never)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-cormorant"></a>`cormorant` **DORRIT**: She says the sea keeps what it takes. Then she charges me for the rum. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:124</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-never"></a>`never` **DORRIT**: No. He would have to admit where it came from, and Vex never admits anything. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:127</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-why3"></a>`why3` **DORRIT**: Because I fed this island for forty years and it never once asked if I was all right. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:130</sub>
- *→ continues at* [why4](#dlg-dorrit-why4)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-why4"></a>`why4` **DORRIT**: Then you came asking. So here I am. Don't make it strange. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:133</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[entry points opened directly from elsewhere, or reached only from them:]*

*[thief: opened directly from rooms/warehouse.adv:42]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-thief"></a>`thief` **FENN (V.O.)**: I knock on the top crate. The breathing stops. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:64</sub>
- *→ continues at* [voice](#dlg-dorrit-voice)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-voice"></a>`voice` **FENN (V.O.)**: A man's voice, behind the crates. 'Don't call Pike. Please.' <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:67</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'm not Pike. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:68</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [notpike](#dlg-dorrit-notpike)
- **2.** **FENN**: You're the one who took the stores. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:69</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [took](#dlg-dorrit-took)
- **3.** **FENN**: Come out where I can see you. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:70</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [come](#dlg-dorrit-come)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-notpike"></a>`notpike` **FENN (V.O.)**: 'They all say that,' he says. 'Then they call Pike.' <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:72</sub>
- *→ continues at* [come](#dlg-dorrit-come)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-come"></a>`come` **FENN (V.O.)**: A man stands up from behind the crates. His coat is stiff with salt. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:78</sub>
- *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-dorrit-confess)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-confess"></a>`confess` **FENN (V.O.)**: 'Pike paid me,' he says. 'Two crowns and a meal. I moved the stores to his shed.' <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:81</sub>
- *[chart:* Pike paid the man in the boat shed to move the stores. Vex's spare rudder is in Pike's shed.*]* <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:82</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: And the Marrow's rudder? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:83</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [rudder](#dlg-dorrit-rudder)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why did you do it? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:84</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why2](#dlg-dorrit-why2)
- **3.** **FENN**: You stole from Dorrit. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:85</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [stole](#dlg-dorrit-stole)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-rudder"></a>`rudder` **FENN (V.O.)**: 'The rudder's in Pike's shed. He took it himself. He said it was owed.' <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:87</sub>
- *→ continues at* [end](#dlg-dorrit-end)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-end"></a>`end` **FENN (V.O.)**: When I look back, the gap behind the crates is empty. He has gone. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:96</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-why2"></a>`why2` **FENN (V.O.)**: 'I hadn't eaten in three days,' he says. 'I only wanted work.' <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:90</sub>
- *→ continues at* [end](#dlg-dorrit-end) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-stole"></a>`stole` **FENN (V.O.)**: 'I know,' he says. 'I'm sorry.' He says it like he's said it a lot. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:93</sub>
- *→ continues at* [end](#dlg-dorrit-end) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-took"></a>`took` **FENN (V.O.)**: 'I moved them,' he says. 'I didn't take them. There's a difference.' <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:75</sub>
- *→ continues at* [come](#dlg-dorrit-come) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-galley_after"></a>`galley_after` **DORRIT**: The pot is still on. That is the whole news. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:136</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What's in it? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:137</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [pot](#dlg-dorrit-pot) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:138</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[camp: opened directly from rooms/salt_camp.adv:111]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-camp"></a>`camp` **DORRIT**: Seven tents and nobody cooking. What kind of camp is that? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:143</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where is everyone? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:144</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [camp_gone](#dlg-dorrit-camp_gone)
- **2.** **FENN**: What about the hut? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:145</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [camp_hut](#dlg-dorrit-camp_hut)
- **3.** **FENN**: How are you holding up? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:146</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [holding](#dlg-dorrit-holding)
- **4.** **FENN**: Tell me about the wreck. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:147</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreck](#dlg-dorrit-wreck)
- **5.** **FENN**: And Vex? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:148</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [vex](#dlg-dorrit-vex)
- **6.** **FENN**: What about my father? <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:149</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [elias](#dlg-dorrit-elias)
- **7.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:150</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-camp_gone"></a>`camp_gone` **DORRIT**: Gone. Every one. The washing is still out. That's what I can't get past. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:152</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-dorrit-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-camp_hut"></a>`camp_hut` **DORRIT**: Locked from the outside. Somebody was afraid of their own cook. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:155</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-dorrit-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-holding"></a>`holding` **DORRIT**: I lost forty spoons and a good pan. I'm furious. Don't tell anyone. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:158</sub>
- *→ continues at* [holding2](#dlg-dorrit-holding2)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-holding2"></a>`holding2` **DORRIT**: Furious is better than frightened. I've had practice. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:161</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-dorrit-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-wreck"></a>`wreck` **DORRIT**: The water came in and the deck went quiet. I held on to Hobb's arm and thought about my spoons. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:164</sub>
- *→ continues at* [wreck2](#dlg-dorrit-wreck2)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-wreck2"></a>`wreck2` **DORRIT**: Then I was in the boat. I don't remember the rest. I don't want to. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:167</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-dorrit-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-vex"></a>`vex` **DORRIT**: He never said thank you for the soup. That's not the crime. But I noticed. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:170</sub>
- *→ continues at* [vex2](#dlg-dorrit-vex2)

<a id="dlg-dorrit-vex2"></a>`vex2` **DORRIT**: The crime is he sailed us into that fog and called it weather. Soup doesn't cover that. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:173</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-dorrit-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-dorrit-elias"></a>`elias` **DORRIT**: He's thin. I'll make him something. Don't tell him it's porridge. <sub>dialogue/dorrit.adv:176</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-dorrit-camp) *(above)*

<a id="act1-office"></a>
## The Harbourmaster's House

*[room* `office`*]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act I, if seen:bramwick.root = false and office_called = false]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:15</sub>
  - *[sets office_called]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:16</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Bramwick is at his desk with his coat on. He looks like a man who has stopped going home. <sub>rooms/office.adv:17</sub>

**Harbourmaster Bramwick** `bramwick` <sub>rooms/office.adv:21</sub>

- **Look at:** Harbourmaster Bramwick. Thirty years of harbour business, and all of it has settled in his face. <sub>rooms/office.adv:24</sub>
- **Talk to:** I clear my throat. Bramwick finishes writing before he looks up. <sub>rooms/office.adv:25</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [bramwick](#dlg-bramwick) *— below]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:26</sub>
- **Give:** He takes nothing he has not signed for. <sub>rooms/office.adv:27</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:bramwick.root]* *— called “Bramwick”* <sub>rooms/office.adv:28</sub>
  - **Look at:** Bramwick. He has not moved, but the papers on his desk have been squared away. <sub>rooms/office.adv:30</sub>
  - **Talk to:** *[→ conversation* [bramwick at again](#dlg-bramwick-again) *— below]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:31</sub>

**the harbourmaster's desk** `desk` <sub>rooms/office.adv:33</sub>

- **Look at:** The harbourmaster's desk. A lamp, a log book, and more paper than the harbour has ships. <sub>rooms/office.adv:36</sub>
- **Use:** I have nothing to put on a harbourmaster's desk that would not insult us both. <sub>rooms/office.adv:38</sub>
- **Open:** The desk has a drawer, and the drawer is locked. <sub>rooms/office.adv:37</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:bramwick.root]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:39</sub>
  - **Look at:** The desk. The log book is closed, which I have never seen before. <sub>rooms/office.adv:40</sub>

**the locked drawer** `drawer` <sub>rooms/office.adv:42</sub>

- **Look at:** A deep drawer with a brass keyhole. Bramwick's drawers are like his answers: locked and well made. <sub>rooms/office.adv:45</sub>
- **Use:** It needs a key, and I am not a key. <sub>rooms/office.adv:48</sub>
- **Open:** Locked. I am not going to crowbar a harbourmaster's desk. <sub>rooms/office.adv:46</sub>
- **Pull:** I pull. The drawer makes a small, satisfied noise. <sub>rooms/office.adv:47</sub>

**the window** `window` <sub>rooms/office.adv:50</sub>

- **Look at:** The harbour, framed. One ship, and a great deal of empty water. <sub>rooms/office.adv:53</sub>
- **Open:** Painted shut. Bramwick does not believe in fresh air or new ideas. <sub>rooms/office.adv:54</sub>
- *When* *[if vex_deal]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:55</sub>
  - **Look at:** The harbour, framed. The Marrow has a new rudder on her rail. <sub>rooms/office.adv:56</sub>
    - **FENN (V.O.)**: Bramwick has not looked out of this window in a week. <sub>rooms/office.adv:57</sub>

**the harbour door** `door_out` <sub>rooms/office.adv:61</sub>

- **Look at:** The door back to the docks. <sub>rooms/office.adv:65</sub>
- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Dreadwater Harbour]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:64</sub>
- **Open:** I go back out to the harbour. <sub>rooms/office.adv:66</sub>
  - *[→ goes to Dreadwater Harbour]* <sub>rooms/office.adv:64</sub>

<a id="dlg-bramwick"></a>
### Conversation: bramwick (Harbourmaster Bramwick)

*[source:* `dialogue bramwick`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-bramwick-root"></a>`root` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Fenn. You came back. I hoped you would stay away. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:2</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where is my father? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:3</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [father](#dlg-bramwick-father)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why is the harbour empty? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [harbour](#dlg-bramwick-harbour)
- **3.** **FENN**: I need a ship. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship)
- **4.** **FENN**: You wrote him off, didn't you? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [guilt](#dlg-bramwick-guilt)
- **5.** **FENN**: Nothing. I'll come back. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:7</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-father"></a>`father` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: The Shroud took him. Three months ago. No wreck, no boat, no body. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:9</sub>
- *→ continues at* [father2](#dlg-bramwick-father2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-father2"></a>`father2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: I have known every ship in this harbour for twenty years. I know what a lost one looks like. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:11</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then find me one that isn't lost. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:12</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship)
- **2.** **FENN**: What is the Shroud? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:13</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shroud](#dlg-bramwick-shroud)
- **3.** **FENN**: Did anyone go after him? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:14</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [search](#dlg-bramwick-search)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-ship"></a>`ship` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: One ship still sails from Dreadwater. The Marrow. She belongs to Captain Vex. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:50</sub>
- *→ continues at* [ship2](#dlg-bramwick-ship2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-ship2"></a>`ship2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Vex works the fog's edge. He will not go into it. Nobody will. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:52</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where do I find him? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:53</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [where](#dlg-bramwick-where)
- **2.** **FENN**: Then I will ask him myself. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:54</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [where](#dlg-bramwick-where)
- **3.** **FENN**: Why will nobody sail? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:55</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [afraid](#dlg-bramwick-afraid)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-where"></a>`where` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Vex keeps the counting house at the top of Wreckers' Lane. The one with the green lamps. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:57</sub>
- *→ continues at* [where2](#dlg-bramwick-where2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-where2"></a>`where2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: If you need a crew, start at the Salty Keel. Marta knows every soul on this island. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:59</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll go and ask Vex. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:60</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why won't anyone sail? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:61</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [afraid](#dlg-bramwick-afraid)
- **3.** **FENN**: Goodnight. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:62</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-bye"></a>`bye` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Fenn. If you go out there, come back. I am too old to write another one. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:91</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-afraid"></a>`afraid` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Because the last three crews are still out there. The town counts them every Sunday. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:64</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then I will count them too. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:65</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Who still sails? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:66</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-shroud"></a>`shroud` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: The fog bank off the headland. It was old when I was a boy, and it has not moved. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:23</sub>
- *→ continues at* [shroud2](#dlg-bramwick-shroud2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-shroud2"></a>`shroud2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Ships go in. The fog keeps them. That is all anyone knows for certain. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:25</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: And the town blames Vex? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:26</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [blame](#dlg-bramwick-blame)
- **2.** **FENN**: Who still sails? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:27</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*
- **3.** **FENN**: Thank you. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:28</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-blame"></a>`blame` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Vex is the only captain who comes back. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:30</sub>
- *→ continues at* [blame2](#dlg-bramwick-blame2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-blame2"></a>`blame2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: People need someone to blame who is still here. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:32</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Is he guilty? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:33</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [guilty](#dlg-bramwick-guilty)
- **2.** **FENN**: Who still sails? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:34</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-guilty"></a>`guilty` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: I don't know. I have known enough guilty men to know one can still be useful. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:36</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: That is not an answer. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:37</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [guilty2](#dlg-bramwick-guilty2)
- **2.** **FENN**: Who still sails? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:38</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-guilty2"></a>`guilty2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: No. It is a harbourmaster's answer. I am sorry. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:39</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Tell me about Vex. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:40</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodnight. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:41</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-search"></a>`search` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Two boats went out. One came back with her sails set and nobody aboard. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:16</sub>
- *→ continues at* [search2](#dlg-bramwick-search2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-search2"></a>`search2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: The other did not come back. That was in the first month. Nobody has tried since. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:18</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What is the Shroud? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:19</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shroud](#dlg-bramwick-shroud) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Who still sails? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:20</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*
- **3.** **FENN**: I am sorry I asked. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:21</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-harbour"></a>`harbour` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Three ships came in this month. Two left. The rest of the fleet is in the fog, or under it. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:43</sub>
- *→ continues at* [harbour2](#dlg-bramwick-harbour2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-harbour2"></a>`harbour2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: The town is frightened, Fenn. Frightened people stop being kind. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:45</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Who still sails? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:46</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: What is the Shroud? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:47</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shroud](#dlg-bramwick-shroud) *(above)*
- **3.** **FENN**: I'll come back. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:48</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-guilt"></a>`guilt` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: I wrote your father down as lost. It took one line. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:68</sub>
- *→ continues at* [guilt2](#dlg-bramwick-guilt2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-guilt2"></a>`guilt2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: I have read that line every morning since. It does not improve. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:70</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then give me a ship. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:71</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I don't want your sorry. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:72</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [hard](#dlg-bramwick-hard)
- **3.** **FENN**: Goodnight. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:73</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-hard"></a>`hard` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: No. You want him back. So do I. I cannot do that either. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:74</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then give me a ship. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:75</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodnight. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:76</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

*[entry points opened directly from elsewhere, or reached only from them:]*

*[again: opened directly from rooms/office.adv:31]*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-again"></a>`again` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Back again. The harbour has not improved, and neither have I. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:78</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Vex says he won't sail. *[if met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:79</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [after_vex](#dlg-bramwick-after_vex)
- **2.** **FENN**: Tell me about Vex. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:80</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [ship](#dlg-bramwick-ship) *(above)*
- **3.** **FENN**: Tell me about my father. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:81</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [father](#dlg-bramwick-father) *(above)*
- **4.** **FENN**: Nothing. Goodnight. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:82</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-bramwick-after_vex"></a>`after_vex` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Vex says no before he has heard the question. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:83</sub>
- *→ continues at* [after_vex2](#dlg-bramwick-after_vex2)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-after_vex2"></a>`after_vex2` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: Find what he wants. Then he will move. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:85</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll find it. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:86</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: What does he want? <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:87</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [after_vex3](#dlg-bramwick-after_vex3)

<a id="dlg-bramwick-after_vex3"></a>`after_vex3` **HARBOURMASTER BRAMWICK**: I don't know. He does not tell me anything he can sell. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:88</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then I'll ask him. <sub>dialogue/bramwick.adv:89</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-bramwick-bye) *(above)*

<a id="act1-alley"></a>
## Wreckers' Lane

*[room* `alley`*]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act I, if alley_seen = false]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:27</sub>
  - *[sets alley_seen]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:28</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Wreckers' Lane. Every door is shut except one, and the lamps are still lit. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:29</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: A young man in a grey coat is writing on a clipboard under them. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:30</sub>
- *Once,* *[if alley_way_out_seen = false]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:34</sub>
  - *[sets alley_way_out_seen]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:35</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Up the lane, past Vex's lamps and the shipwright's lit window, the boat shed's latch is up and its door stands open a hand's width. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:36</sub>

**Pike** `pike` <sub>rooms/alley.adv:40</sub>

- **Look at:** Pike. Grey coat, yellow armband, and a clipboard he holds like a shield. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:43</sub>
- **Talk to:** He lowers the clipboard a little. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:44</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [pike](#dlg-pike) *— below]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:45</sub>
- **Give:** He writes something down instead of taking it. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:46</sub>
- *When* *[if rudder_back]* *— called “Pike”* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:47</sub>
  - **Look at:** Pike. The clipboard is under his arm now. He looks like a man who has just been audited. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:49</sub>
  - **Talk to:** *[→ conversation* [pike at after](#dlg-pike-after) *— below]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:50</sub>

**the wreckers' shed** `shed` <sub>rooms/alley.adv:52</sub>

- **Look at:** A lean-to under the stairs, packed with crates of ships' stores. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:55</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Somebody has scraped the shipping marks off. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:56</sub>
  - *[sets saw_stores]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:57</sub>
- **Open:** The lean-to is tied shut with a length of chain. The chain is loose enough to be a suggestion. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:58</sub>
- **Push:** The chain rattles, and Pike's pencil stops moving. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:59</sub>
- *When* *[if rudder_back]* *— called “the picked-over shed”* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:60</sub>
  - **Look at:** The lean-to is tidier than it was. The chain is down, and the best crates have gone. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:62</sub>

**the boat shed door** `boat_shed` <sub>rooms/alley.adv:66</sub>

- **Look at:** The boat shed. The latch is up, and the door is open a hand's width. Somebody is inside. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:70</sub>
- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Boat Shed]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:69</sub>
- **Open:** I push the door. It gives quietly, as if it has been opened carefully before. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:71</sub>
  - *[→ goes to The Boat Shed]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:69</sub>
- *When* *[if dorrit_cleared]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:72</sub>
  - **Look at:** The boat shed. The door is shut now, and the latch is down. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:73</sub>
  - **Open:** The shed is quiet. Dorrit has packed his spoons. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:74</sub>

**the counting house door** `counting_door` <sub>rooms/alley.adv:78</sub>

- **Look at:** A warehouse door with a lamp above it. The paint is newer than the rest of the lane. Vex's counting house. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:82</sub>
- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Vex's Warehouse]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:81</sub>
- **Open:** I go up the lane to Vex's warehouse. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:83</sub>
  - *[→ goes to Vex's Warehouse]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:81</sub>

**the shipwright's door** `chandlery_door` <sub>rooms/alley.adv:87</sub>

- **Look at:** The shipwright's window, lit and full of rope. Open late, because ships are always leaving. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:91</sub>
- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Shipwright's]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:90</sub>
- **Open:** I push the door. A bell somewhere in the shop regrets it. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:92</sub>
  - *[→ goes to The Shipwright's]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:90</sub>

**the lane back down to the docks** `to_dock` <sub>rooms/alley.adv:96</sub>

- **Look at:** The lane runs back down to the waterfront. <sub>rooms/alley.adv:100</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Dreadwater Harbour]* <sub>rooms/alley.adv:99</sub>

<a id="dlg-pike"></a>
### Conversation: pike (Pike)

*[source:* `dialogue pike`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-pike-root"></a>`root` **PIKE**: This lane is private. Wreckers' business. You are not on the list. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:2</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Who are the wreckers? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:3</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreckers](#dlg-pike-wreckers)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's in the shed? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shed](#dlg-pike-shed)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'm looking for Vex's rudder. *[if met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [rudder](#dlg-pike-rudder)
- **4.** **FENN**: The man you paid talked. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess)
- **5.** **FENN**: Step aside. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:7</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [aside](#dlg-pike-aside)
- **6.** **FENN**: Sorry. Wrong lane. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:8</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye)

<a id="dlg-pike-wreckers"></a>`wreckers` **PIKE**: We take what the fog leaves. Ships, cargo, anything that floats. It is salvage. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:10</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: And the people? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:11</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [people](#dlg-pike-people)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's in the shed? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:12</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shed](#dlg-pike-shed)
- **3.** **FENN**: The man you paid talked. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:13</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess)
- **4.** **FENN**: I'm looking for Vex's rudder. *[if met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:14</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [rudder](#dlg-pike-rudder)

<a id="dlg-pike-people"></a>`people` **PIKE**: We don't take people. People are not salvage. There is a rule. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:16</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You have a rule for people? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [form](#dlg-pike-form)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's in the shed? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:18</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shed](#dlg-pike-shed)

<a id="dlg-pike-form"></a>`form` **PIKE**: There is a rule for everything. That is what makes it a profession. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:19</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What's in the shed? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:20</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shed](#dlg-pike-shed)
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodbye. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:21</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye)

<a id="dlg-pike-shed"></a>`shed` **PIKE**: Stores. Some of it ours, some of it waiting to be ours. It is all written down. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:23</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Those crates came from the boat shed. *[if saw_stores]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:24</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [stores](#dlg-pike-stores)
- **2.** **FENN**: And Vex's rudder? *[if saw_stores and met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:25</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [rudder](#dlg-pike-rudder)
- **3.** **FENN**: Right. Sorry. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:26</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye)

<a id="dlg-pike-stores"></a>`stores` **PIKE**: They came ashore by themselves. Everything comes ashore by itself. That is how salvage works. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:28</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The man you paid told me. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:29</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess)
- **2.** **FENN**: The crates are from the boat shed. *[if saw_stores]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:30</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [crates](#dlg-pike-crates)
- **3.** **FENN**: That is not how salvage works. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:31</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [argue](#dlg-pike-argue)

<a id="dlg-pike-confess"></a>`confess` **PIKE**: Wen. He cannot keep his mouth shut for two crowns. I should have known. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:61</sub>
- *→ continues at* [confess2](#dlg-pike-confess2)

<a id="dlg-pike-confess2"></a>`confess2` **PIKE**: So I paid him. So the stores are mine. That does not make the rudder yours. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:63</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Vex wants it back. *[if met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:64</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [caught](#dlg-pike-caught)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll take it to Vex myself. *[if met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:65</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [caught](#dlg-pike-caught)
- **3.** **FENN**: Goodbye. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:66</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye)

<a id="dlg-pike-caught"></a>`caught` **PIKE**: All right. Take the rudder. I will write it off as weather and a bad night. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:68</sub>
- *→ continues at* [caught2](#dlg-pike-caught2)

<a id="dlg-pike-caught2"></a>`caught2` **PIKE**: And tell the cook I did not steal his name. I only took the stores. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:70</sub>
- *[sets rudder_back]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:71</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll tell him. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:72</sub>
  - *[ends]*
- **2.** **FENN**: You'll tell him yourself. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:73</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [caught3](#dlg-pike-caught3)

<a id="dlg-pike-caught3"></a>`caught3` **PIKE**: I would rather not. He has a wooden spoon and strong opinions. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:74</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then stay out of the Salty Keel. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:75</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-pike-bye"></a>`bye` **PIKE**: Mind the chain on your way out. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:89</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-pike-crates"></a>`crates` **PIKE**: Crates are crates. The boat shed is full of them, and none of them have names. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:32</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The man you paid told me. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:33</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodbye. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:34</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-pike-argue"></a>`argue` **PIKE**: It is if I write it down. I am very careful about what I write down. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:35</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The man you paid told me. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:36</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodbye. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:37</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-pike-rudder"></a>`rudder` **PIKE**: Vex's rudder? I don't have Vex's rudder. I have a rudder. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:39</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The man you paid told me. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:40</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: The stores in your shed are stolen too. *[if saw_stores]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:41</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [crates](#dlg-pike-crates) *(above)*
- **3.** **FENN**: Then where is it? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:42</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [where](#dlg-pike-where)
- **4.** **FENN**: I'll find it myself. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:43</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-pike-where"></a>`where` **PIKE**: Ask the man who found it. I only catalogued it. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:44</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Who found it? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:45</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [finder](#dlg-pike-finder)
- **2.** **FENN**: The man you paid told me. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:46</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-pike-finder"></a>`finder` **PIKE**: A survivor. They come out of the fog sometimes. They don't talk much, and they don't stay. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:47</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where is he now? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:48</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [survivor](#dlg-pike-survivor)
- **2.** **FENN**: Did you pay him to steal for you? <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:49</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [accused](#dlg-pike-accused)

<a id="dlg-pike-survivor"></a>`survivor` **PIKE**: The boat shed, most likely. He sleeps where the stores used to be. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:50</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: He told me already. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:51</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll find him. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:52</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-pike-accused"></a>`accused` **PIKE**: I paid him for salvage. The stores were salvage. The rudder was salvage. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:54</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The man you paid told me. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:55</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Salvage is theft with a longer word. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:56</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [caught_soft](#dlg-pike-caught_soft)

<a id="dlg-pike-caught_soft"></a>`caught_soft` **PIKE**: It is a longer word. That is why I use it. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:57</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The man you paid told me. *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:58</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [confess](#dlg-pike-confess) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodbye. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:59</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-pike-aside"></a>`aside` **PIKE**: You are not a wrecker. You are a clerk in a wet coat. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:77</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'm the clerk who knows Vex. *[if met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:78</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [rudder](#dlg-pike-rudder) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I'm the clerk who is asking nicely. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:79</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [nice](#dlg-pike-nice)
- **3.** **FENN**: Goodbye. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:80</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-pike-nice"></a>`nice` **PIKE**: Nicely is not a category. Come back with a category. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:81</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Goodbye. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:82</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-pike-bye) *(above)*

*[entry points opened directly from elsewhere, or reached only from them:]*

*[after: opened directly from rooms/alley.adv:50]*

<a id="dlg-pike-after"></a>`after` **PIKE**: The rudder's on its way to the Marrow. I have the record. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:84</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Good. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:85</sub>
  - *[ends]*
- **2.** **FENN**: Stay out of the boat shed. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:86</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [after2](#dlg-pike-after2)

<a id="dlg-pike-after2"></a>`after2` **PIKE**: The boat shed is not my department. <sub>dialogue/pike.adv:87</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="act1-village"></a>
## Upper Town

*[room* `village`*]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[if seen:marta.father and village_father_room = false]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:21</sub>
  - *[sets village_father_room]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:22</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The window over the Salty Keel's back door. My father's room. The shutters are open and the lamp is out. <sub>rooms/village.adv:23</sub>
- *Once,* *[if village_way_out_seen = false]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:26</sub>
  - *[sets village_way_out_seen]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:27</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The harbour steps drop away past the well, and the lane to the light climbs out between the stalls at the far end of the street. <sub>rooms/village.adv:28</sub>

**Nell** `nell` <sub>rooms/village.adv:30</sub>

- **Look at:** Nell, behind a stall of rope and dried fish. She's already decided what I'm going to buy. <sub>rooms/village.adv:33</sub>
- **Talk to:** She looks at me the way she looks at weather. <sub>rooms/village.adv:34</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [nell](#dlg-nell) *— below]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:35</sub>
- **Give:** She takes goods, not charity. <sub>rooms/village.adv:36</sub>
- **Open:** Nell is not a stall, though she has been mistaken for one. <sub>rooms/village.adv:37</sub>

**Tam** `tam` <sub>rooms/village.adv:39</sub>

- **Look at:** A boy in a cap two sizes too big, counting something under his breath. He's always counting. <sub>rooms/village.adv:42</sub>
- **Talk to:** He's already turned round. He was waiting for someone to talk to. <sub>rooms/village.adv:43</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [tam](#dlg-tam) *— below]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:44</sub>
- **Give:** He looks at my hands and decides they're empty. <sub>rooms/village.adv:45</sub>
- **Open:** He is not a cupboard. He'd probably fit in one. <sub>rooms/village.adv:46</sub>

**Old Onn** `onn` <sub>rooms/village.adv:48</sub>

- **Look at:** An old woman sweeping cobbles that were already clean. <sub>rooms/village.adv:51</sub>
- **Talk to:** She stops sweeping before I say anything. <sub>rooms/village.adv:52</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [onn](#dlg-onn) *— below]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:53</sub>
- **Give:** She waves it away. She's done taking things from this harbour. <sub>rooms/village.adv:54</sub>
- **Open:** She is not a door, and she'd have something to say about being asked. <sub>rooms/village.adv:55</sub>

**the well** `well` <sub>rooms/village.adv:57</sub>

- **Look at:** A stone well with a windlass and a bucket. The water down there is older than the harbour. <sub>rooms/village.adv:60</sub>
- **Use:** I draw a bucket. It's cold and tastes of stone. Best thing I've had all night. <sub>rooms/village.adv:61</sub>
- **Pull:** The windlass turns. Somewhere below, a bucket fills. <sub>rooms/village.adv:62</sub>

**market stalls** `stalls` <sub>rooms/village.adv:64</sub>

- **Look at:** Rope, lamp oil, dried fish. Everything a ship needs and nobody is buying. <sub>rooms/village.adv:67</sub>
- **Use:** I've no money and no need. Two things that rarely arrive together. <sub>rooms/village.adv:68</sub>

**the shrine** `shrine` <sub>rooms/village.adv:70</sub>

- **Look at:** A niche with a painted figure and a shelf of candle stubs. Somebody still lights them. <sub>rooms/village.adv:73</sub>
- **Use:** I put a coin in the box. It's the least I can do, and it is exactly that. <sub>rooms/village.adv:74</sub>
- **Open:** The niche is open, as niches are. <sub>rooms/village.adv:75</sub>
- **Pull:** I'm not going to rifle a shrine. <sub>rooms/village.adv:76</sub>

**washing line** `washing` <sub>rooms/village.adv:78</sub>

- **Look at:** Ten shirts on a line between two houses. Somebody is still washing for men who aren't coming home. <sub>rooms/village.adv:81</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:onn.crew]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:82</sub>
  - **Look at:** Ten shirts on the line. Onn counted ten men off this street. Somebody still washes for them. <sub>rooms/village.adv:83</sub>

**the houses** `cottages` <sub>rooms/village.adv:85</sub>

- **Look at:** The houses lean on each other. Half the windows are dark, and it isn't late. <sub>rooms/village.adv:88</sub>

**the window above the back door** `father_room` <sub>rooms/village.adv:90</sub>

- **Look at:** A window over a back door. The shutters are open and the lamp is out. <sub>rooms/village.adv:93</sub>
- **Use:** The window is shut. The back door below is bolted from the inside. <sub>rooms/village.adv:94</sub>
- **Open:** The window is shut. The back door below is bolted from the inside. <sub>rooms/village.adv:95</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:marta.father]* *— called “the room above the tavern”* <sub>rooms/village.adv:96</sub>
  - **Look at:** My father's room, over the Salty Keel's back door. The shutters are open and the lamp is out. <sub>rooms/village.adv:98</sub>

**the steps down to the harbour** `steps_down` <sub>rooms/village.adv:103</sub>

- **Look at:** The top of the steps down to the harbour. The lamps are on and the street is empty. <sub>rooms/village.adv:107</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Dreadwater Harbour]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:106</sub>

**the lane up to the light** `light_path` <sub>rooms/village.adv:110</sub>

- **Look at:** A stone lane between the houses, climbing towards the lighthouse. <sub>rooms/village.adv:114</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Lighthouse]* <sub>rooms/village.adv:113</sub>

**Combinations here**

- **Use Elias's compass on Tam:** He holds it to his ear like a shell. 'It doesn't point north.' <sub>rooms/village.adv:117</sub>
- **Use Elias's compass on Old Onn:** She doesn't take it. 'Keep your father's things, child.' <sub>rooms/village.adv:119</sub>

<a id="dlg-nell"></a>
### Conversation: nell (Nell)

*[source:* `dialogue nell`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-nell-root"></a>`root` **NELL**: Elias Fenn's boy, back from the mainland. Buying, or loitering? I charge for both. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:2</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What's the news? <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:3</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [news](#dlg-nell-news)
- **2.** **FENN**: What are you selling? <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [selling](#dlg-nell-selling)
- **3.** **FENN**: Tell me about the village. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [village](#dlg-nell-village)
- **4.** **FENN**: Anything strange on the water? <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [strange](#dlg-nell-strange)
- **5.** **FENN**: Just looking. Goodnight. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:7</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye)

<a id="dlg-nell-news"></a>`news` **NELL**: Half the boats are tied up. The other half are for sale. Nobody's buying. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:8</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Why not? <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:9</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why](#dlg-nell-why)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's for sale? <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:10</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [sale](#dlg-nell-sale)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'll look elsewhere. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:11</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye)

<a id="dlg-nell-why"></a>`why` **NELL**: Because the fog took six ships, and nobody wants to be the seventh. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:12</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye)

<a id="dlg-nell-bye"></a>`bye` **NELL**: Go on. If you hear anything out there, I'm buying. News, I mean. Not rope. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:32</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-nell-sale"></a>`sale` **NELL**: Rope, nets, a dinghy with a good name. The owners have gone inland. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:14</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-nell-selling"></a>`selling` **NELL**: Rope, lamp oil, dried fish, and gossip. The fish is fresher. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:16</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-nell-village"></a>`village` **NELL**: Forty houses and a well. Half are empty since the ships stopped coming back. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:18</sub>
- *→ continues at* [village2](#dlg-nell-village2)

<a id="dlg-nell-village2"></a>`village2` **NELL**: The rest are related. That's why it's quiet. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:20</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: It looks peaceful. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:21</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [peaceful](#dlg-nell-peaceful)
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodnight, Nell. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:22</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-nell-peaceful"></a>`peaceful` **NELL**: It is. That's what worries me. A harbour town should sound like a harbour. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:23</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-nell-strange"></a>`strange` **NELL**: The fog's closer this month. On still nights the fishermen won't go past the reef. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:25</sub>
- *→ continues at* [strange2](#dlg-nell-strange2)

<a id="dlg-nell-strange2"></a>`strange2` **NELL**: Old Onn says the water goes quiet out there. I sell rope, not answers. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:27</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll ask her. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:28</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: What do you think it is? <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:29</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [think](#dlg-nell-think)

<a id="dlg-nell-think"></a>`think` **NELL**: I think a harbour town should sound like a harbour. This one doesn't. <sub>dialogue/nell.adv:30</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-nell-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-tam"></a>
### Conversation: tam (Tam)

*[source:* `dialogue tam`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-tam-root"></a>`root` **TAM**: You're Elias Fenn's boy. Everyone on the wall says you're going into the fog. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:2</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: How does everyone know? <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:3</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [know](#dlg-tam-know)
- **2.** **FENN**: What are you doing up here? <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [count](#dlg-tam-count)
- **3.** **FENN**: Have you seen anything strange? <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [strange](#dlg-tam-strange)
- **4.** **FENN**: Maybe. Goodnight. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-tam-bye)

<a id="dlg-tam-know"></a>`know` **TAM**: I count the ships from the corner. People talk in front of me. I'm short. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:7</sub>
- *→ continues at* [count](#dlg-tam-count)

<a id="dlg-tam-count"></a>`count` **TAM**: Nine or ten a week, before. Now it's three, and two of those are the Marrow. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:9</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Which boat is the Marrow? <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:10</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [which](#dlg-tam-which)
- **2.** **FENN**: That's a good tally. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:11</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-tam-bye)

<a id="dlg-tam-which"></a>`which` **TAM**: Uncle Hobb mends boats at the shipwright's. He's got Dad on his arm, in ink. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:12</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where's your dad? <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:13</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [strange](#dlg-tam-strange)
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodnight, Tam. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:14</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-tam-bye)

<a id="dlg-tam-strange"></a>`strange` **TAM**: The Arcadia came round the headland faster than anything. I timed her. Then she stopped. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:15</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: She was my father's ship. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:16</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [captain](#dlg-tam-captain)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'm sorry. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [dad](#dlg-tam-dad)
- **3.** **FENN**: Ships stop. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:18</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [stop](#dlg-tam-stop)

<a id="dlg-tam-captain"></a>`captain` **TAM**: You're the captain's? Then you're not a stranger. You're on the tally. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:19</sub>
- *→ continues at* [dad](#dlg-tam-dad)

<a id="dlg-tam-dad"></a>`dad` **TAM**: Dad went with her. Tam Hobb, able seaman. I'm Tam too. Mum only has to shout once. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:23</sub>
- *→ continues at* [dad2](#dlg-tam-dad2)

<a id="dlg-tam-dad2"></a>`dad2` **TAM**: Mum says not to talk about it. So I tell strangers. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:25</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll look for them. All of them. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:26</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [promise](#dlg-tam-promise)
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodnight, Tam. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:27</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-tam-bye)

<a id="dlg-tam-promise"></a>`promise` **TAM**: If you find Dad, tell him the tally's still running. Tell him I kept counting. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:28</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-tam-bye)

<a id="dlg-tam-bye"></a>`bye` **TAM**: Goodnight. That's you counted. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:30</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-tam-stop"></a>`stop` **TAM**: She was never late. Not once. <sub>dialogue/tam.adv:21</sub>
- *→ continues at* [dad](#dlg-tam-dad) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-onn"></a>
### Conversation: onn (Old Onn)

*[source:* `dialogue onn`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-onn-root"></a>`root` **OLD ONN**: Mind the cobbles. They're wet, and I've swept them twice. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:2</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You knew the Arcadia's crew? <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:3</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [crew](#dlg-onn-crew)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's wrong with the water past the reef? <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [water](#dlg-onn-water)
- **3.** **FENN**: Do you need help? <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [help](#dlg-onn-help)
- **4.** **FENN**: I'll leave you to it. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-onn-bye)

<a id="dlg-onn-crew"></a>`crew` **OLD ONN**: My husband's cousin. The boy from the end house. Ten off this street. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:7</sub>
- *→ continues at* [crew2](#dlg-onn-crew2)

<a id="dlg-onn-crew2"></a>`crew2` **OLD ONN**: I counted them out. I counted them back. Only the first part worked. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:9</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What happened to them? <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:10</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [water](#dlg-onn-water)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'm sorry, Onn. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:11</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [sorry](#dlg-onn-sorry)

<a id="dlg-onn-water"></a>`water` **OLD ONN**: Past the reef the water goes quiet. Not calm. Quiet. The fishermen won't say its name. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:14</sub>
- *→ continues at* [water2](#dlg-onn-water2)

<a id="dlg-onn-water2"></a>`water2` **OLD ONN**: They call it the Shroud. Don't say it twice. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:16</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What do you think it is? <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [think](#dlg-onn-think)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll be careful. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:18</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-onn-bye)

<a id="dlg-onn-think"></a>`think` **OLD ONN**: I think it's old. Older than the harbour, older than the name. It was here first. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:19</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-onn-bye)

<a id="dlg-onn-bye"></a>`bye` **OLD ONN**: Mind the cobbles. I've swept them twice. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:30</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-onn-sorry"></a>`sorry` **OLD ONN**: Don't be sorry. Be useful. Find out what's out there. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:12</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-onn-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-onn-help"></a>`help` **OLD ONN**: No, child. I have the broom, the step, and a lot of time. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:21</sub>
- *→ continues at* [help2](#dlg-onn-help2)

<a id="dlg-onn-help2"></a>`help2` **OLD ONN**: What I want is one person to come back and tell me what's out there. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:23</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll try. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:24</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [promise](#dlg-onn-promise)
- **2.** **FENN**: I can't promise that. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:25</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [honest](#dlg-onn-honest)

<a id="dlg-onn-promise"></a>`promise` **OLD ONN**: Then try. When you know, come and tell me. Not the harbourmaster. Me. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:26</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-onn-bye) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-onn-honest"></a>`honest` **OLD ONN**: No. Nobody can. That's why I'm asking anyway. <sub>dialogue/onn.adv:28</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bye](#dlg-onn-bye) *(above)*

<a id="act1-quay"></a>
## The Quay

*[room* `quay`*]* <sub>rooms/quay.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[if quay_seen = false]* <sub>rooms/quay.adv:26</sub>
  - *[sets quay_seen]* <sub>rooms/quay.adv:27</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The water opens here. The harbourmaster's house behind me, the pier and the lighthouse ahead. <sub>rooms/quay.adv:28</sub>

**the harbour mouth** `harbour_mouth` <sub>rooms/quay.adv:33</sub>

- **Look at:** The stone quay runs out along the water. Past the last lamp is the harbour mouth. <sub>rooms/quay.adv:37</sub>
- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Harbour Mouth]* <sub>rooms/quay.adv:36</sub>
- **Open:** I walk out along the quay toward the harbour mouth. <sub>rooms/quay.adv:38</sub>
  - *[→ goes to The Harbour Mouth]* <sub>rooms/quay.adv:36</sub>

**the harbour** `harbour` <sub>rooms/quay.adv:40</sub>

- **Look at:** The boards run back past the harbourmaster's house to the harbour. The Marrow is tied up beyond it. <sub>rooms/quay.adv:44</sub>
- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Dreadwater Harbour]* <sub>rooms/quay.adv:43</sub>
- **Open:** I follow the boards back into the harbour. <sub>rooms/quay.adv:45</sub>
  - *[→ goes to Dreadwater Harbour]* <sub>rooms/quay.adv:43</sub>

**the lighthouse** `lighthouse` <sub>rooms/quay.adv:47</sub>

- **Look at:** The lighthouse on the point. It burns for the harbour mouth, and it does not reach the fog. <sub>rooms/quay.adv:50</sub>

**the Marrow's bow** `marrow` <sub>rooms/quay.adv:52</sub>

- **Look at:** The Marrow's bow, high above the boards. Her gear is aloft, as if she were leaving. <sub>rooms/quay.adv:55</sub>

<a id="act1-warehouse"></a>
## The Boat Shed

*[room* `warehouse`*]* <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act I, if boat_shed_arrived = false]* <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:18</sub>
  - *[sets boat_shed_arrived]* <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:19</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The boat shed. The island's stores in the dark, and one stack turned wrong. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:20</sub>

**the desk** `desk` <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:22</sub>
