- **Look at:** A desk in a boat shed: a candle, three books, and a week of dust. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:25</sub>
- **Use:** The candle is fresh. Somebody has been sitting here. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:27</sub>
- **Open:** The drawer is empty except for a fish hook and a smell of salt. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:26</sub>

**the books** `books` <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:29</sub>

- **Look at:** Three books, swollen with damp. The top one is a book of sea stories. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:32</sub>
- **Use:** The pages are stuck together. The story is about a ship that came back. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:33</sub>

**the stores** `stores` <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:35</sub>

- **Look at:** The boat shed's stores: crates, barrels, salt beef. One corner is stacked wrong. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:39</sub>
- **Talk to:** I knock on the top crate. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:41</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [dorrit at thief](#dlg-dorrit-thief) *— see Act I › The Salty Keel]* <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:42</sub>
- **Use:** I count what's left. Dorrit has already counted it twice. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:40</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:dorrit.confess]* <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:43</sub>
  - **Look at:** The stores, stacked wrong at the corner. The gap behind them is empty now. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:44</sub>
  - **Talk to:** There's nobody behind the stores. The thief has gone. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:45</sub>

**the crates** `crates` <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:47</sub>

- **Look at:** Three crates, stacked neat. The top one has been opened and closed again. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:50</sub>
- **Use:** The nails are new. Somebody has been at this stack in a hurry. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:51</sub>

**the hoist** `hoist` <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:53</sub>

- **Look at:** A block and tackle. The rope is new, and the hook is still swinging. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:56</sub>
- **Use:** I give the rope a pull. Something in the loft shifts and settles. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:57</sub>

**the lane door** `lane_door` <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:61</sub>

- **Look at:** The lane door, open a hand's width. Fog light comes through. <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:65</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Wreckers' Lane]* <sub>rooms/warehouse.adv:64</sub>

<a id="act1-counting_house"></a>
## Vex's Warehouse

*[room* `counting_house`*]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act I, if vex_warehouse_arrived = false]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:25</sub>
  - *[sets vex_warehouse_arrived]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:26</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Vex's warehouse. Desks, green lamps, and one very good safe. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:27</sub>

**the lane door** `door_out` <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:30</sub>

- **Look at:** The lane door. Oiled hinges, and no lock. Vex likes to hear who comes in. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:34</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Wreckers' Lane]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:33</sub>

**the portrait** `portrait` <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:36</sub>

- **Look at:** The last owner in oils: top hat, sword, and a chin the painter improved. Vex bought the warehouse with the portrait still hanging. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:39</sub>
- **Talk to:** I ask why he keeps it. Vex says it is the only honest man in the room, and he likes to be reminded what honesty looks like. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:40</sub>

**the pigeonholes** `pigeonholes` <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:42</sub>

- **Look at:** Rolled charts in every hole, one for each ship that didn't come home. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:45</sub>
- **Use:** Vex calls this his library. The sea calls it salvage. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:46</sub>

**the desks** `desks` <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:48</sub>

- **Look at:** Five tall desks, pens out, no clerks. Vex does his own accounts and enjoys it. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:51</sub>
- **Use:** I straighten a pen. It was already straight. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:53</sub>
- **Open:** The drawers are locked. The keys are on a ring in Vex's pocket, alphabetised. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:52</sub>

**the strongbox** `safe` <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:55</sub>

- **Look at:** A black safe with a brass dial. Vex says it holds tide tables. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:58</sub>
- **Use:** It is bolted through the floor. The floor seems nervous about it. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:60</sub>
- **Open:** The dial is worn smooth on one side. Vex opens it with his thumb and a look. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:59</sub>

**the brass cloud** `brass_cloud` <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:62</sub>

- **Look at:** A brass cloud over the door. Vex says it's his family crest. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:65</sub>
- **Use:** I've seen that cloud on salvage from three ships. Vex says it's a coincidence. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:66</sub>

**Captain Vex** `vex` <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:68</sub>

- **Look at:** Captain Vex, in a coat worth more than the Marrow. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:71</sub>
- **Talk to:** I take my hat off. He likes that. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:72</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [vex](#dlg-vex) *— below]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:73</sub>
- *When* *[if vex_deal]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:74</sub>
  - **Look at:** Captain Vex, counting the tide. He is already spending the salvage. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:75</sub>
  - **Talk to:** He is in a better mood than usual, which is worse. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:76</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [vex at deal_done](#dlg-vex-deal_done) *— below]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:77</sub>
- *When* *[if rudder_back]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:78</sub>
  - **Talk to:** He has seen the rudder. He is deciding how grateful to look. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:79</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [vex at rudder](#dlg-vex-rudder) *— below]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:80</sub>
- *When* *[if met_vex]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:81</sub>
  - **Talk to:** He does not look up from the desk. <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:82</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [vex at no_rudder](#dlg-vex-no_rudder) *— below]* <sub>rooms/counting_house.adv:83</sub>

<a id="dlg-vex"></a>
### Conversation: vex (Captain Vex)

*[source:* `dialogue vex`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-vex-root"></a>`root` **CAPTAIN VEX**: That compass. I know it. Elias Fenn's, unless I'm wrong. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:2</sub>
- *[sets met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:3</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I need the Marrow. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [need](#dlg-vex-need)
- **2.** **FENN**: They say you're the only one sailing. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [only](#dlg-vex-only)
- **3.** **FENN**: Nothing. Good day. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:6</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-need"></a>`need` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The Marrow doesn't sail. She's had enough of the fog. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:8</sub>
- *→ continues at* [terms](#dlg-vex-terms)

<a id="dlg-vex-terms"></a>`terms` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Pike's wreckers took my spare rudder. Bring it back and we'll talk. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:14</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where would Pike keep it? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:15</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [where](#dlg-vex-where)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll get it. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:16</sub>
  - *[ends]*
- **3.** **FENN**: Find another rudder. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [another](#dlg-vex-another)

<a id="dlg-vex-where"></a>`where` **CAPTAIN VEX**: His shed in Wreckers' Lane. Take someone who can run. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:22</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-another"></a>`another` **CAPTAIN VEX**: There isn't another. Pike has the only one that fits. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:19</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-only"></a>`only` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Sailing is a strong word. I sit in the harbour and charge for it. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:11</sub>
- *→ continues at* [terms](#dlg-vex-terms) *(above)*

*[entry points opened directly from elsewhere, or reached only from them:]*

*[no_rudder: opened directly from rooms/counting_house.adv:83]*

<a id="dlg-vex-no_rudder"></a>`no_rudder` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Still no rudder. Still no voyage. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:25</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where would Pike keep it? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:26</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [where](#dlg-vex-where) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I'm working on it. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:27</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[rudder: opened directly from rooms/counting_house.adv:80]*

<a id="dlg-vex-rudder"></a>`rudder` **CAPTAIN VEX**: That is my rudder. You're either very good or very lucky. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:29</sub>
- *[sets met_vex]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:30</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Now talk. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:31</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [deal](#dlg-vex-deal)
- **2.** **FENN**: The rudder for a passage. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:32</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [deal](#dlg-vex-deal)
- **3.** **FENN**: Keep it. I'll find another captain. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:33</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bluff](#dlg-vex-bluff)

<a id="dlg-vex-deal"></a>`deal` **CAPTAIN VEX**: My ship. My rules. Half the salvage. I captain. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:38</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Agreed. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:39</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [sail](#dlg-vex-sail)
- **2.** **FENN**: My father first. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:40</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [father](#dlg-vex-father)
- **3.** **FENN**: Half is robbery. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:41</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [half](#dlg-vex-half)

<a id="dlg-vex-sail"></a>`sail` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then it's a voyage. Bring a cook and a carpenter. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:50</sub>
- *[sets vex_deal]* *[sets quill_compass]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:51</sub>
- *[chart:* Vex will sail: his ship, his rules, half the salvage. He returned Quill's compass.*]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:53</sub>
- *→ continues at* [compass](#dlg-vex-compass)

<a id="dlg-vex-compass"></a>`compass` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Take Quill's compass. Tell her the debt is paid. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:56</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-father"></a>`father` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Your father is a reason, not a cargo. I'll take you to the fog. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:43</sub>
- *→ continues at* [sail](#dlg-vex-sail) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-half"></a>`half` **CAPTAIN VEX**: It is robbery. You're welcome to walk. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:46</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Agreed. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:47</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [sail](#dlg-vex-sail) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll walk. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:48</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-bluff"></a>`bluff` **CAPTAIN VEX**: There isn't another captain. That's the joke. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:35</sub>
- *→ continues at* [deal](#dlg-vex-deal) *(above)*

*[deal_done: opened directly from rooms/counting_house.adv:77]*

<a id="dlg-vex-deal_done"></a>`deal_done` **CAPTAIN VEX**: We sail at the tide. Try not to be late. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:59</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: About the fog. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:60</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fog](#dlg-vex-fog)
- **2.** **FENN**: About my father. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:61</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [my_father](#dlg-vex-my_father)
- **3.** **FENN**: What's in the safe? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:62</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [salvage](#dlg-vex-salvage)
- **4.** **FENN**: Nothing. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:63</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-fog"></a>`fog` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The fog takes ships. I take passengers. We understand each other. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:65</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-my_father"></a>`my_father` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Elias Fenn sailed in with a good crew. I'm not him. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:68</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-salvage"></a>`salvage` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Tide tables, mostly. And a few things the sea owed me. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:71</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Those charts have ship names on them. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:72</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [charts](#dlg-vex-charts)
- **2.** **FENN**: Never mind. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:73</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-charts"></a>`charts` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Salvage. The sea gives, and I keep. That's the trade. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:75</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[helm: opened directly from rooms/marrow_quarterdeck.adv:37]*

<a id="dlg-vex-helm"></a>`helm` **CAPTAIN VEX**: You're on my quarterdeck, clerk. Say your piece. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:80</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What are we doing out here? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:81</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [edge](#dlg-vex-edge)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why the bow? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:82</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bow](#dlg-vex-bow)
- **3.** **FENN**: Nothing. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:83</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-edge"></a>`edge` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The edge of the Shroud. Close enough to see it, far enough to leave. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:85</sub>
- *→ continues at* [send](#dlg-vex-send)

<a id="dlg-vex-send"></a>`send` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Take the bow. Call the water. If it calls back, don't answer. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:91</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Call the water? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:92</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [call](#dlg-vex-call)
- **2.** **FENN**: You're serious. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:93</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [serious](#dlg-vex-serious)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'm going. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:94</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-call"></a>`call` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Old trick. A voice at the bow tells the fog we're only weather. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:96</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: And if it doesn't believe us? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:97</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [believe](#dlg-vex-believe)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll call it. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:98</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-believe"></a>`believe` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then we run. Quietly. That's the whole plan. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:100</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-serious"></a>`serious` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I am always serious. It's the coat that makes people doubt me. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:103</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-bow"></a>`bow` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Because the fog has a voice, and I want to hear it before it hears us. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:88</sub>
- *→ continues at* [send](#dlg-vex-send) *(above)*

*[helm_done: opened directly from rooms/marrow_quarterdeck.adv:45]*

<a id="dlg-vex-helm_done"></a>`helm_done` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The bow. I meant what I said about calling the water. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:106</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What if it answers? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:107</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [answer](#dlg-vex-answer)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'm going. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:108</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-answer"></a>`answer` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then we learn something. Try not to. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:110</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[after_fog: opened directly from rooms/marrow_quarterdeck.adv:41]*

<a id="dlg-vex-after_fog"></a>`after_fog` **CAPTAIN VEX**: You're back. Good. I was starting to think the fog had taste. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:113</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The bell rang on its own. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:114</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bell](#dlg-vex-bell)
- **2.** **FENN**: It's still out there. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:115</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [out](#dlg-vex-out)

<a id="dlg-vex-bell"></a>`bell` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Bells do that, on ships. In stories. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:117</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-out"></a>`out` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then we keep the light low and our mouths shut. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:120</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[confront: opened directly from rooms/marrow_quarterdeck.adv:49]*

<a id="dlg-vex-confront"></a>`confront` **CAPTAIN VEX**: You've seen the hold. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:123</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Those crates have ships' names on them. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:124</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [names](#dlg-vex-names)
- **2.** **FENN**: How long have you been stripping wrecks? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:125</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [howlong](#dlg-vex-howlong)
- **3.** **FENN**: The crew saw. They know what you are. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:126</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [crew](#dlg-vex-crew)

<a id="dlg-vex-names"></a>`names` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Names are all that is left of them. I keep the names dry. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:128</sub>
- *→ continues at* [admit](#dlg-vex-admit)

<a id="dlg-vex-admit"></a>`admit` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The sea takes. I keep what it drops. I don't apologise for weather. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:137</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: My father was on one of those ships. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:138</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [about_father](#dlg-vex-about_father)
- **2.** **FENN**: You're a thief. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:139</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [thief](#dlg-vex-thief)
- **3.** **FENN**: Take us home. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:140</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [home](#dlg-vex-home)

<a id="dlg-vex-about_father"></a>`about_father` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I know. I didn't put him there. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:142</sub>
- *→ continues at* [decision](#dlg-vex-decision)

<a id="dlg-vex-decision"></a>`decision` **CAPTAIN VEX**: No. We go deeper. I'll prove it's only weather. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:151</sub>
- *[sets vex_exposed]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:152</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You'll get us killed. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:153</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [refuse](#dlg-vex-refuse)
- **2.** **FENN**: Then we all go. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:154</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [together](#dlg-vex-together)

<a id="dlg-vex-refuse"></a>`refuse` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Maybe. Not today. Hold the rail. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:156</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-together"></a>`together` **CAPTAIN VEX**: That's the spirit. Hold on to something. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:159</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-thief"></a>`thief` **CAPTAIN VEX**: A thief with a ship. The only kind that sails. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:145</sub>
- *→ continues at* [decision](#dlg-vex-decision) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-home"></a>`home` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Home is the one heading I can't sell. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:148</sub>
- *→ continues at* [decision](#dlg-vex-decision) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-howlong"></a>`howlong` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Since before your father sailed. The fog is a good supplier. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:131</sub>
- *→ continues at* [admit](#dlg-vex-admit) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-crew"></a>`crew` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then they can hate me on the way back. It is how I am paid. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:134</sub>
- *→ continues at* [admit](#dlg-vex-admit) *(above)*

*[last: opened directly from rooms/marrow_quarterdeck.adv:53, rooms/marrow_quarterdeck.adv:64]*

<a id="dlg-vex-last"></a>`last` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I'm taking her deeper. You can watch, or you can swim. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:162</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The light. It hunts light, doesn't it? *[if rule_light]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:163</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [last_light](#dlg-vex-last_light)
- **2.** **FENN**: You'll get us killed. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:164</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [last_kill](#dlg-vex-last_kill)
- **3.** **FENN**: Then I'm with you. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:165</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [last_go](#dlg-vex-last_go)

<a id="dlg-vex-last_light"></a>`last_light` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then we go dark. Hold on to something. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:167</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gone](#dlg-vex-gone)

<a id="dlg-vex-gone"></a>`gone` **FENN (V.O.)**: Vex puts both hands on the wheel and turns her past the last pencil mark. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:176</sub>
- *[music: music_fog]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:177</sub>
- *→ continues at* [sun](#dlg-vex-sun)

<a id="dlg-vex-sun"></a>`sun` **FENN (V.O.)**: The sun goes first. Then the colour. Then the rails. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:180</sub>
- *→ continues at* [deeper_fog](#dlg-vex-deeper_fog)

<a id="dlg-vex-deeper_fog"></a>`deeper_fog` **FENN (V.O.)**: The fog comes up the hull like water up a stair. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:183</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bell_rings](#dlg-vex-bell_rings)

<a id="dlg-vex-bell_rings"></a>`bell_rings` **FENN (V.O.)**: Somewhere ahead, a bell rings. There is no hand on the rope. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:186</sub>
- *[sound: chime]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:187</sub>
- *→ continues at* [dark](#dlg-vex-dark)

<a id="dlg-vex-dark"></a>`dark` **FENN (V.O.)**: The lanterns gutter. The dark comes down and stays. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:190</sub>
- *→ continues at* [under](#dlg-vex-under)

<a id="dlg-vex-under"></a>`under` **FENN (V.O.)**: Something vast passes under the keel. The deck lifts, and keeps lifting. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:193</sub>
- *→ continues at* [green](#dlg-vex-green)

<a id="dlg-vex-green"></a>`green` **FENN (V.O.)**: A green light opens in the fog. A ship rises out of it, older than the island. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:196</sub>
- *→ continues at* [lantern_name](#dlg-vex-lantern_name)

<a id="dlg-vex-lantern_name"></a>`lantern_name` **FENN (V.O.)**: Her name is on the stern, grey under the salt. The Grey Lantern. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:199</sub>
- *→ continues at* [voice](#dlg-vex-voice)

<a id="dlg-vex-voice"></a>`voice` **FENN (V.O.)**: I don't see her captain. I hear him. He welcomes the Marrow aboard. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:202</sub>
- *→ continues at* [taken](#dlg-vex-taken)

<a id="dlg-vex-taken"></a>`taken` **FENN (V.O.)**: The deck goes out from under me. Cold, a rope, Hobb shouting my name. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:205</sub>
- *→ continues at* [boat](#dlg-vex-boat)

<a id="dlg-vex-boat"></a>`boat` **FENN (V.O.)**: Then the longboat. Then the wreck behind us, and the fog closing its door. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:208</sub>
- *[sets marrow_lost]* *[→ Act II ends]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:209</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-last_kill"></a>`last_kill` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Probably. Hold on to something. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:170</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gone](#dlg-vex-gone) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-last_go"></a>`last_go` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Good. Hold on to something. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:173</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gone](#dlg-vex-gone) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-shore"></a>`shore` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Stranded on a fog flat with a crew that would happily leave me here. I've had worse mornings. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:215</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What do we do now? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:216</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shore_what](#dlg-vex-shore_what)
- **2.** **FENN**: The crew wants answers. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:217</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shore_crew](#dlg-vex-shore_crew)
- **3.** **FENN**: What did you see out there? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:218</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shore_saw](#dlg-vex-shore_saw)
- **4.** **FENN**: Nothing. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:219</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-shore_what"></a>`shore_what` **CAPTAIN VEX**: We walk. The camp is up the flats, and your father's chart is the only map worth having. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:221</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You're coming with us. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:222</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shore_coming](#dlg-vex-shore_coming)
- **2.** **FENN**: Don't fall behind. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:223</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-shore_coming"></a>`shore_coming` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Somebody has to carry the oars. You'd only drop them. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:225</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-shore_crew"></a>`shore_crew` **CAPTAIN VEX**: They can want. Wanting is free. Rowing is not. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:228</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: They think you left him. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:229</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shore_saw](#dlg-vex-shore_saw)
- **2.** **FENN**: Give them something. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:230</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shore_give](#dlg-vex-shore_give)
- **3.** **FENN**: Nothing. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:231</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-shore_saw"></a>`shore_saw` **CAPTAIN VEX**: You want the part I didn't say on the Marrow. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:236</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Tell me. *[if seen:vex.saw_elias = false]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:237</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_elias](#dlg-vex-saw_elias)
- **2.** **FENN**: Tell me again. *[if seen:vex.saw_elias]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:238</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_again](#dlg-vex-saw_again)
- **3.** **FENN**: Not now. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:239</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_elias"></a>`saw_elias` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I saw him. Off the reef, standing on a rock, waving a lantern. I turned the wheel and my light away. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:241</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You left him there. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:242</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_left](#dlg-vex-saw_left)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:243</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_why](#dlg-vex-saw_why)
- **3.** **FENN**: You're telling me now. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:244</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_now](#dlg-vex-saw_now)

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_left"></a>`saw_left` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Yes. I left him. I'm not going to make it sound better than that. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:246</sub>
- *→ continues at* [saw_fear](#dlg-vex-saw_fear)

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_fear"></a>`saw_fear` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I've been afraid since the first ship I lost. Fear is the only crew that stays. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:255</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then be useful. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:256</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_useful](#dlg-vex-saw_useful)
- **2.** **FENN**: You're a coward. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:257</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_coward](#dlg-vex-saw_coward)
- **3.** **FENN**: I've heard enough. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:258</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_useful"></a>`saw_useful` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I know the reef water. I know how she hunts. That's worth a boat and an oar. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:260</sub>
- *→ continues at* [saw_deal](#dlg-vex-saw_deal)

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_deal"></a>`saw_deal` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I'm not on your side. I'm on the boat's side. The boat's on mine. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:266</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: That will have to do. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:267</sub>
  - *[ends]*
- **2.** **FENN**: Don't make me regret it. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:268</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [saw_regret](#dlg-vex-saw_regret)

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_regret"></a>`saw_regret` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I make everyone regret something. You'll fit right in. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:270</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_coward"></a>`saw_coward` **CAPTAIN VEX**: A live coward. The best kind, and the only kind that gets old. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:263</sub>
- *→ continues at* [saw_deal](#dlg-vex-saw_deal) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_why"></a>`saw_why` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The fog was between us. I was on the wrong side of it, and I stayed there. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:249</sub>
- *→ continues at* [saw_fear](#dlg-vex-saw_fear) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_now"></a>`saw_now` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Because you'd have found out. You're the sort who finds out. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:252</sub>
- *→ continues at* [saw_fear](#dlg-vex-saw_fear) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-saw_again"></a>`saw_again` **CAPTAIN VEX**: A light, off the reef. I told myself it was a lamp on a buoy. It wasn't. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:273</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-shore_give"></a>`shore_give` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I have a boat, a coat, and a good story. Two of those are useful. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:233</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-wreck"></a>`wreck` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I know this water. I've been picking at it for years, and it never picks back. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:277</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Whose ship was she? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:278</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreck_ship](#dlg-vex-wreck_ship)
- **2.** **FENN**: What do you know about the nameplate? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:279</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreck_plate](#dlg-vex-wreck_plate)
- **3.** **FENN**: Did you see my father here? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:280</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [shore_saw](#dlg-vex-shore_saw) *(above)*
- **4.** **FENN**: Nothing. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:281</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-wreck_ship"></a>`wreck_ship` **CAPTAIN VEX**: A ship the fog took. There are enough of them out here to make a reef. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:283</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Did you take anything off her? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:284</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreck_took](#dlg-vex-wreck_took)
- **2.** **FENN**: Leave her alone. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:285</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-wreck_took"></a>`wreck_took` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Cargo. Names. Nothing that answered me. That is the whole trade. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:287</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-wreck_plate"></a>`wreck_plate` **CAPTAIN VEX**: A name, cut into brass. The sea keeps the rest of the ship, but not that. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:290</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Whose name? *[if rule_name = false]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:291</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreck_plate_unknown](#dlg-vex-wreck_plate_unknown)
- **2.** **FENN**: I've read it. *[if rule_name]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:292</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreck_plate_known](#dlg-vex-wreck_plate_known)
- **3.** **FENN**: Never mind. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:293</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-wreck_plate_unknown"></a>`wreck_plate_unknown` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I don't know. Reading it costs more light than I like to spend. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:295</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-wreck_plate_known"></a>`wreck_plate_known` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then keep it behind your teeth until we're aboard. Names carry. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:298</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[gate: opened directly from rooms/key_gate.adv:59, rooms/key_gate.adv:130]*

<a id="dlg-vex-gate"></a>`gate` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The gate stays shut until I like the plan. I don't like it yet. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:302</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What is missing? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:303</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gate_what](#dlg-vex-gate_what)
- **2.** **FENN**: Elias is with us. *[if elias_found]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:304</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gate_elias](#dlg-vex-gate_elias)
- **3.** **FENN**: We have the third rule. *[if rule_name]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:305</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gate_rule](#dlg-vex-gate_rule)
- **4.** **FENN**: Hobb has a plan for the bell. *[if bell_plan]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:306</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gate_bell](#dlg-vex-gate_bell)
- **5.** **FENN**: Then stay here. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:307</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-gate_what"></a>`gate_what` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Count them off. I'll tell you which one I don't believe. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:309</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Elias and the rules. *[if elias_found = false]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:310</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [missing_elias](#dlg-vex-missing_elias)
- **2.** **FENN**: The name. *[if rule_name = false]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:311</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [missing_name](#dlg-vex-missing_name)
- **3.** **FENN**: Hobb's plan for the bell. *[if bell_plan = false]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:312</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [missing_bell](#dlg-vex-missing_bell)
- **4.** **FENN**: All three are done. *[if elias_found and bell_plan and rule_name]* <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:313</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gate_all](#dlg-vex-gate_all)
- **5.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:314</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-missing_elias"></a>`missing_elias` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Your father has the rules. Until he says them, we are guessing at the fog. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:316</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-missing_name"></a>`missing_name` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The name is the whole trick. Without it, we are just noise in the fog. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:319</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-missing_bell"></a>`missing_bell` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Hobb's plan. I want to hear how he means to take a bell off a dead ship. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:322</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-gate_all"></a>`gate_all` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Then we are ready. I hate being ready. It means something is about to happen. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:325</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-gate_elias"></a>`gate_elias` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Your father is alive. Good. Dead men don't draw maps. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:328</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-gate_rule"></a>`gate_rule` **CAPTAIN VEX**: The name. Say it and she cannot take us. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:331</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-gate_bell"></a>`gate_bell` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Hobb's plan. If it involves climbing, I'm holding the rope from down here. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:334</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[board: opened directly from rooms/key_gate.adv:126]*

<a id="dlg-vex-board"></a>`board` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I row you out. After that, I'm a passenger with a good coat. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:338</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Why are you coming? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:339</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_why](#dlg-vex-board_why)
- **2.** **FENN**: What do I do when we're aboard? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:340</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_what](#dlg-vex-board_what)
- **3.** **FENN**: What about the others? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:341</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_crew](#dlg-vex-board_crew)
- **4.** **FENN**: Let's go. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:342</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_go](#dlg-vex-board_go)

<a id="dlg-vex-board_why"></a>`board_why` **CAPTAIN VEX**: If you die out there, they'll say I let you. I'd rather be a witness. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:344</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: That's not a reason. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:345</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_reason](#dlg-vex-board_reason)
- **2.** **FENN**: It'll do. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:346</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_go](#dlg-vex-board_go)

<a id="dlg-vex-board_reason"></a>`board_reason` **CAPTAIN VEX**: It's the only reason I have that isn't fear. Take it. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:348</sub>
- *→ continues at* [board_go](#dlg-vex-board_go)

<a id="dlg-vex-board_go"></a>`board_go` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Get in. Try not to rock her. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:361</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-vex-board_what"></a>`board_what` **CAPTAIN VEX**: Stay where I can see you. Bell first, then the light, then the name. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:351</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: And you? <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:352</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_you](#dlg-vex-board_you)
- **2.** **FENN**: Right. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:353</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [board_go](#dlg-vex-board_go) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-board_you"></a>`board_you` **CAPTAIN VEX**: I'll be at the oars. Somebody has to be ready to leave. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:355</sub>
- *→ continues at* [board_go](#dlg-vex-board_go) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-vex-board_crew"></a>`board_crew` **CAPTAIN VEX**: They follow you. I follow the boat. It works out the same. <sub>dialogue/vex.adv:358</sub>
- *→ continues at* [board_go](#dlg-vex-board_go) *(above)*

<a id="act1-chandlery"></a>
## The Shipwright's

*[room* `chandlery`*]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act I, if chandlery_arrived = false]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:20</sub>
  - *[sets chandlery_arrived]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:21</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The shipwright's shop. Tar, sawdust, and a mast against the back wall. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:22</sub>
- *Once,* *[Act I, if quill_compass and seen:quill.join = false]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:24</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Quill is at the counter, holding out her empty hand. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:25</sub>

**the counter** `counter` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:27</sub>

- **Look at:** A long counter: a brass scale, a lantern, and a hundred small things ships need. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:30</sub>
- **Use:** I could price a whole ship off this counter. I'd rather not. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:32</sub>
- **Open:** The counter is a counter. The shipwright keeps his money in his boot. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:31</sub>

**the brass scale** `scale` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:34</sub>

- **Look at:** A brass scale, polished. The shipwright weighs everything twice and charges once. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:37</sub>
- **Use:** I put a finger on the pan. The scale thinks about it and says nothing. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:38</sub>

**the shelves** `shelves` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:40</sub>

- **Look at:** Coils of rope, bolts of canvas, a dozen lanterns. Everything a ship needs to come back. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:43</sub>
- **Use:** Good rope. Good canvas. None of it does you much good in the fog. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:44</sub>

**the sailcloth** `sailcloth` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:46</sub>

- **Look at:** Bolts of sailcloth, still in their wrapping. The shipwright charges by the yard. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:49</sub>
- **Use:** The canvas is good. It would make a fine sail for a ship with a mast. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:50</sub>

**the ship's lantern** `lantern` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:52</sub>

- **Look at:** A ship's lantern, lit. The glass is clean and the wick is new. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:55</sub>
- **Use:** I could carry it. The shipwright would notice before I reached the door. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:56</sub>

**the crowbar** `crowbar` *[present if doesn't have Hobb's crowbar]* *[Pick up gives: Hobb's crowbar]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:58</sub>

- **Look at:** Hobb's crowbar, red with old rust. It has opened more ships than it has closed. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:63</sub>
- **Pick up:** I take the crowbar off the counter. Nobody stops me. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:64</sub>

**Quill** `quill` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:66</sub>

- **Look at:** Quill: sharp, quick, and standing where she can see the door. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:69</sub>
- **Talk to:** She looks me over the way she'd look over a chart. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:70</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [quill](#dlg-quill) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:71</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:quill.join]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:72</sub>
  - **Talk to:** She is checking the rigging with her eyes. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:73</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [quill at after](#dlg-quill-after) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:74</sub>
- *When* *[if quill_compass]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:75</sub>
  - **Talk to:** She is already holding out her hand. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:76</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [quill at got](#dlg-quill-got) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:77</sub>
- *When* *[if met_quill]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:78</sub>
  - **Talk to:** She is watching the fog through the window. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:79</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [quill at again](#dlg-quill-again) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:80</sub>

**Hobb** `hobb` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:82</sub>

- **Look at:** Hobb: a big man with folded arms and no interest in small talk. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:85</sub>
- **Talk to:** He looks at me. He waits. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:86</sub>
  - *[→ conversation* [hobb](#dlg-hobb) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:87</sub>
- *When* *[if seen:hobb.joined]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:88</sub>
  - **Talk to:** He is still looking at the mast. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:89</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [hobb at after](#dlg-hobb-after) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:90</sub>
- *When* *[if hobb_joined]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:91</sub>
  - **Talk to:** He is still looking at the mast. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:92</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [hobb at joined](#dlg-hobb-joined) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:93</sub>
- *When* *[if met_hobb]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:94</sub>
  - **Talk to:** He does not look up from the band. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:95</sub>
    - *[→ conversation* [hobb at again](#dlg-hobb-again) *— below]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:96</sub>

**the Marrow's mast** `mast` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:98</sub>

- **Look at:** The Marrow's mast, standing against the back wall. The iron band at the counter is seized. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:102</sub>
- **Use:** The band at the counter won't move. It needs a lever. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:103</sub>
- *When* *[if hobb_joined]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:104</sub>
  - **Look at:** The mast, banded and sound. Hobb rests one hand on it. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:105</sub>
  - **Use:** The band is sound now. Hobb would only make me do it again. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:106</sub>
- *When* *[if has Hobb's crowbar]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:107</sub>
  - **Look at:** The iron band at the counter is seized. The crowbar will shift it. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:108</sub>
  - **Use:** I need to put the crowbar to it. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:109</sub>

**the lane door** `door_out` <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:113</sub>

- **Look at:** The lane door. The shipwright keeps it open for the smell of the sea. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:117</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Wreckers' Lane]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:116</sub>

**Combinations here**

- **Use Hobb's crowbar on the Marrow's mast:** *[if hobb_joined]* The band is sound. Hobb would only make me do it again. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:120</sub>
- **Use Hobb's crowbar on the Marrow's mast:** I get the bar under the iron band and lean. The band shifts with a crack. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:122</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Hobb puts one hand flat on the mast. He does not say anything. <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:123</sub>
  - *[sets hobb_joined]* *[sound: chime]* <sub>rooms/chandlery.adv:124</sub>

<a id="dlg-quill"></a>
### Conversation: quill (Quill)

*[source:* `dialogue quill`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-quill-root"></a>`root` **QUILL**: Marta says the cartographer is back. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:2</sub>
- *[sets met_quill]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:3</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I need a navigator. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [want](#dlg-quill-want)
- **2.** **FENN**: You're Quill. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [name](#dlg-quill-name)
- **3.** **FENN**: Who told you that? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [marta](#dlg-quill-marta)
- **4.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:7</sub>
  - *[ends]*
- **5.** **FENN**: Anything out there? *[Act II only]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:8</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [aboard](#dlg-quill-aboard)

<a id="dlg-quill-want"></a>`want` **QUILL**: Vex won't sail. And I won't sail without my compass. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:16</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where's your compass? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [compass](#dlg-quill-compass)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why won't Vex sail? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:18</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why](#dlg-quill-why)
- **3.** **FENN**: Then I'll find another crew. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:19</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-compass"></a>`compass` **QUILL**: Vex has it. I owe him for a passage, so he keeps it in his pocket. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:25</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What do you owe him? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:26</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [debt](#dlg-quill-debt)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll get it back. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:27</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [promise](#dlg-quill-promise)
- **3.** **FENN**: Good luck with that. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:28</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-debt"></a>`debt` **QUILL**: Half a passage. I paid the rest in work. He says lookout work doesn't count. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:30</sub>
- *→ continues at* [promise](#dlg-quill-promise)

<a id="dlg-quill-promise"></a>`promise` **QUILL**: Bring it back and I'll navigate you past the fog. Any fog. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:33</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-why"></a>`why` **QUILL**: Ask him. He's been counting his money all morning. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:21</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where's your compass? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:22</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [compass](#dlg-quill-compass) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll ask him. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:23</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-name"></a>`name` **QUILL**: Quill. Lookout on the Marrow, and a better navigator than the one we've got. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:13</sub>
- *→ continues at* [want](#dlg-quill-want) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-marta"></a>`marta` **QUILL**: Marta tells everyone everything. It's how the island stays alive. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:10</sub>
- *→ continues at* [want](#dlg-quill-want) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-aboard"></a>`aboard` **QUILL**: The deck's yours, cartographer. Try not to chart the rigging. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:66</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What's the fog doing? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:67</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [leaning](#dlg-quill-leaning)
- **2.** **FENN**: Where's Vex? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:68</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [vex_at](#dlg-quill-vex_at)
- **3.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:69</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-leaning"></a>`leaning` **QUILL**: From the island it looked flat. Out here it is leaning to windward, like a sail. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:74</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Fog doesn't lean. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:75</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [lean2](#dlg-quill-lean2)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's under it? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:76</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [under](#dlg-quill-under)

<a id="dlg-quill-lean2"></a>`lean2` **QUILL**: This one does. And the sea has gone flat in a stripe under it. A stripe, not a wave. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:78</sub>
- *→ continues at* [under](#dlg-quill-under)

<a id="dlg-quill-under"></a>`under` **QUILL**: Something big and slow is dragging it. The wind is going the other way. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:81</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: That isn't weather. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:82</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [weather](#dlg-quill-weather)
- **2.** **FENN**: Keep watching. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:83</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-weather"></a>`weather` **QUILL**: No. But I would like to be wrong, so I will keep looking. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:85</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-vex_at"></a>`vex_at` **QUILL**: At the chart table with the door shut. He has been in there since the sun came up. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:71</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[entry points opened directly from elsewhere, or reached only from them:]*

*[again: opened directly from rooms/chandlery.adv:80]*

<a id="dlg-quill-again"></a>`again` **QUILL**: Still no compass. Still no voyage. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:36</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where does Vex keep it? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:37</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [compass](#dlg-quill-compass) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I'm working on it. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:38</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[got: opened directly from rooms/chandlery.adv:77]*

<a id="dlg-quill-got"></a>`got` **QUILL**: That's my compass. Vex gave it up? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:40</sub>
- *[sets met_quill]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:41</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: He had no choice. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:42</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gave](#dlg-quill-gave)
- **2.** **FENN**: The debt is paid. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:43</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gave](#dlg-quill-gave)
- **3.** **FENN**: It was in his safe. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:44</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [found](#dlg-quill-found)

<a id="dlg-quill-gave"></a>`gave` **QUILL**: Then he's afraid of something. Good. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:46</sub>
- *→ continues at* [join](#dlg-quill-join)

<a id="dlg-quill-join"></a>`join` **QUILL**: I'm your navigator. I'll take the nest when you need eyes. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:52</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: My father is out there. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:53</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [father](#dlg-quill-father)
- **2.** **FENN**: Welcome aboard. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:54</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-father"></a>`father` **QUILL**: Then we'll find him. I'm good at finding things. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:56</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-found"></a>`found` **QUILL**: Liar. I like it. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:49</sub>
- *→ continues at* [join](#dlg-quill-join) *(above)*

*[after: opened directly from rooms/chandlery.adv:74]*

<a id="dlg-quill-after"></a>`after` **QUILL**: Navigator. Don't make me regret it. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:59</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: My father is out there. *[if seen:quill.father = false]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:60</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [father](#dlg-quill-father) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Welcome aboard. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:61</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[nest: opened directly from rooms/crows_nest.adv:70]*

<a id="dlg-quill-nest"></a>`nest` **QUILL**: You're in my office. Mind the edge. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:89</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What do you see? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:90</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [see](#dlg-quill-see)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why keep watch from up here? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:91</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why_nest](#dlg-quill-why_nest)
- **3.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:92</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-see"></a>`see` **QUILL**: The fog is standing up. Like a sail taking wind, only there is no wind. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:94</sub>
- *→ continues at* [see2](#dlg-quill-see2)

<a id="dlg-quill-see2"></a>`see2` **QUILL**: And there is a sound. Put your ear on the rail. It is like a rope drawn over wood. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:97</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I don't hear anything. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:98</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [hear](#dlg-quill-hear)
- **2.** **FENN**: Something's out there. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:99</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [out](#dlg-quill-out)

<a id="dlg-quill-hear"></a>`hear` **QUILL**: You will. It comes and goes. It came while you were climbing. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:101</sub>
- *→ continues at* [out](#dlg-quill-out)

<a id="dlg-quill-out"></a>`out` **QUILL**: It has been keeping pace since we cleared the harbour. Slow, like it has all day. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:104</sub>
- *[chart:* Quill: the fog leans to windward and the sea goes flat under it. Something big and slow is in the Shroud.*]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:105</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Vex should know. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:106</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [tell](#dlg-quill-tell)
- **2.** **FENN**: What do you want to do? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:107</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [want2](#dlg-quill-want2)

<a id="dlg-quill-tell"></a>`tell` **QUILL**: Vex doesn't come up here. He doesn't like the view. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:109</sub>
- *→ continues at* [want2](#dlg-quill-want2)

<a id="dlg-quill-want2"></a>`want2` **QUILL**: I want the chart table. I can navigate. He has me counting gulls. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:112</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Then navigate us. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:113</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [navigate](#dlg-quill-navigate)
- **2.** **FENN**: Give him time. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:114</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [time](#dlg-quill-time)

<a id="dlg-quill-navigate"></a>`navigate` **QUILL**: Say that to him, and I'll have the chart in one hand and this glass in the other. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:116</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-time"></a>`time` **QUILL**: I have given him long enough. I'm not patient. I'm just up high. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:119</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-why_nest"></a>`why_nest` **QUILL**: Up here I can see the shape of things. Down there I'm a pair of hands. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:122</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[nest_after: opened directly from rooms/crows_nest.adv:73]*

<a id="dlg-quill-nest_after"></a>`nest_after` **QUILL**: Still leaning. Still leaning the wrong way. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:125</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Anything else? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:126</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [out](#dlg-quill-out) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Keep watching. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:127</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[gallery: opened directly from rooms/marrow_gallery.adv:92]*

<a id="dlg-quill-gallery"></a>`gallery` **QUILL**: Off watch. Don't tell anyone. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:130</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Why out here? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:131</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_why](#dlg-quill-gal_why)
- **2.** **FENN**: What is the fog like from the stern? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:132</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_fog](#dlg-quill-gal_fog)
- **3.** **FENN**: How long were you a lookout? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:133</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_lookout](#dlg-quill-gal_lookout)
- **4.** **FENN**: Vex has been stripping the wrecks. *[if salvage_seen]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:134</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_salvage](#dlg-quill-gal_salvage)
- **5.** **FENN**: Goodnight, Quill. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:135</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-gal_why"></a>`gal_why` **QUILL**: Because a ship is only as good as the one who knows where it is. I'm practising. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:144</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gal_more](#dlg-quill-gal_more)

<a id="dlg-quill-gal_more"></a>`gal_more` **FENN (V.O.)**: The sun goes down another inch. The rail is warm where her arm was. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:137</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Why out here? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:138</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_why](#dlg-quill-gal_why) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: What is the fog like from the stern? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:139</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_fog](#dlg-quill-gal_fog)
- **3.** **FENN**: How long were you a lookout? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:140</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_lookout](#dlg-quill-gal_lookout)
- **4.** **FENN**: Vex has been stripping the wrecks. *[if salvage_seen]* <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:141</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_salvage](#dlg-quill-gal_salvage)
- **5.** **FENN**: Goodnight, Quill. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:142</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-gal_fog"></a>`gal_fog` **QUILL**: From here it is a wall. From up top it is a thing with a current in it. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:147</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gal_more](#dlg-quill-gal_more) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-gal_lookout"></a>`gal_lookout` **QUILL**: Four years. I'm done looking at things. I want to know where they are. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:150</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gal_more](#dlg-quill-gal_more) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-gal_salvage"></a>`gal_salvage` **QUILL**: I know. I have been steering round those barrels since we cleared the harbour. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:153</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gal_salvage2](#dlg-quill-gal_salvage2)

<a id="dlg-quill-gal_salvage2"></a>`gal_salvage2` **QUILL**: He pays me. Don't ask me to be sorry for him. Ask me to be better than him. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:156</sub>
- *→ continues at* [gal_more](#dlg-quill-gal_more) *(above)*

*[gallery_after: opened directly from rooms/marrow_gallery.adv:95]*

<a id="dlg-quill-gallery_after"></a>`gallery_after` **QUILL**: The sun is nearly in the sea. It does that every night, and I still watch it. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:159</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Why out here? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:160</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [gal_why](#dlg-quill-gal_why) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Goodnight, Quill. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:161</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[camp: opened directly from rooms/salt_camp.adv:147]*

<a id="dlg-quill-camp"></a>`camp` **QUILL**: Seven tents. A dozen shirts on the line. Nobody. I counted twice. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:167</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Where did they go? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:168</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [camp_gone](#dlg-quill-camp_gone)
- **2.** **FENN**: What about the hut? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:169</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [camp_hut](#dlg-quill-camp_hut)
- **3.** **FENN**: Tell me about the wreck. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:170</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wreck](#dlg-quill-wreck)
- **4.** **FENN**: What about my father? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:171</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [elias](#dlg-quill-elias)
- **5.** **FENN**: And Vex? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:172</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [vex](#dlg-quill-vex)
- **6.** **FENN**: How are you holding up? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:173</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [holding](#dlg-quill-holding)
- **7.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:174</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-camp_gone"></a>`camp_gone` **QUILL**: The fog took them, or the camp did. I don't like either answer. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:176</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-quill-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-camp_hut"></a>`camp_hut` **QUILL**: Locked from the outside. That's not a store. That's a cage. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:179</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-quill-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-wreck"></a>`wreck` **QUILL**: I was in the nest when she went. I heard the bell. Then the water. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:182</sub>
- *→ continues at* [wreck2](#dlg-quill-wreck2)

<a id="dlg-quill-wreck2"></a>`wreck2` **QUILL**: I didn't see what took us. I felt it go past under the hull. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:185</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-quill-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-elias"></a>`elias` **QUILL**: He's alive. Go and be his son for a minute. We can wait. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:194</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-quill-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-vex"></a>`vex` **QUILL**: He took us in to prove he was right. He is still proving it. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:188</sub>
- *→ continues at* [vex2](#dlg-quill-vex2)

<a id="dlg-quill-vex2"></a>`vex2` **QUILL**: I would trust him with a heading. Not with a life. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:191</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-quill-camp) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-holding"></a>`holding` **QUILL**: I lost my ship. I didn't lose you. I'm counting that as a win. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:197</sub>
- *→ continues at* [camp](#dlg-quill-camp) *(above)*

*[pans: opened directly from rooms/far_pans.adv:95]*

<a id="dlg-quill-pans"></a>`pans` **QUILL**: From here the fog looks like weather. That's what I keep telling myself. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:201</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: What do you see? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:202</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [pans_see](#dlg-quill-pans_see)
- **2.** **FENN**: Are you all right? <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:203</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [pans_ok](#dlg-quill-pans_ok)
- **3.** **FENN**: We should go back. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:204</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-quill-pans_see"></a>`pans_see` **QUILL**: The edge of it. It has a line, like a coast. At night the line comes closer. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:206</sub>
- *→ continues at* [pans](#dlg-quill-pans) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-quill-pans_ok"></a>`pans_ok` **QUILL**: No. But the wind is doing something to my eyes, so I'll blame it. <sub>dialogue/quill.adv:209</sub>
- *→ continues at* [pans](#dlg-quill-pans) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-hobb"></a>
### Conversation: hobb (Hobb)

*[source:* `dialogue hobb`*, starts at* `root`*]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:1</sub>

<a id="dlg-hobb-root"></a>`root` **HOBB**: Fenn. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:2</sub>
- *[sets met_hobb]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:3</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Hobb? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:4</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [name](#dlg-hobb-name)
- **2.** **FENN**: What's wrong with the mast? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:5</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [mast](#dlg-hobb-mast)
- **3.** **FENN**: I need a carpenter. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:6</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [need](#dlg-hobb-need)
- **4.** **FENN**: Later. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:7</sub>
  - *[ends]*
- **5.** **FENN**: What's in the hold? *[Act II only]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:8</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [hold](#dlg-hobb-hold)

<a id="dlg-hobb-name"></a>`name` **HOBB**: Bosun. Carpenter. Both. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:10</sub>
- *→ continues at* [mast](#dlg-hobb-mast)

<a id="dlg-hobb-mast"></a>`mast` **HOBB**: The iron band on the mast has seized. I've been at it since dawn. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:16</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Can you free it? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:17</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fix](#dlg-hobb-fix)
- **2.** **FENN**: What do you need? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:18</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [fix](#dlg-hobb-fix)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'll leave you to it. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:19</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-fix"></a>`fix` **HOBB**: A lever, and a hand that isn't holding the mast. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:21</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'll hold it. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:22</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [hand](#dlg-hobb-hand)
- **2.** **FENN**: There's a crowbar on the counter. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:23</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [lever](#dlg-hobb-lever)

<a id="dlg-hobb-hand"></a>`hand` **HOBB**: Then take the crowbar and get under the band. I'll hold her. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:25</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-lever"></a>`lever` **HOBB**: Aye. Use it. I'll hold her. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:28</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-need"></a>`need` **HOBB**: You'll want the Marrow. Everybody wants the Marrow. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:13</sub>
- *→ continues at* [mast](#dlg-hobb-mast) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-hobb-hold"></a>`hold` **HOBB**: Arcadia. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:57</sub>
- *[sets salvage_seen]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:58</sub>
- *→ continues at* [hold2](#dlg-hobb-hold2)

<a id="dlg-hobb-hold2"></a>`hold2` **HOBB**: Tam sailed on her. My brother. And here is her cargo, stacked like firewood. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:61</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Vex has been picking the wrecks. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:62</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [pick](#dlg-hobb-pick)
- **2.** **FENN**: Are you sure it is her? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:63</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [sure](#dlg-hobb-sure)
- **3.** **FENN**: I'm sorry, Hobb. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:64</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [sorry2](#dlg-hobb-sorry2)

<a id="dlg-hobb-pick"></a>`pick` **HOBB**: Picking them clean, and selling it back to the island. At a profit. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:69</sub>
- *→ continues at* [anger](#dlg-hobb-anger)

<a id="dlg-hobb-anger"></a>`anger` **HOBB**: He will answer for it. Not today. Today I am counting barrels. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:72</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-sure"></a>`sure` **HOBB**: I tarred that name on her stern the winter before she sailed. I would know it anywhere. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:66</sub>
- *→ continues at* [pick](#dlg-hobb-pick) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-hobb-sorry2"></a>`sorry2` **HOBB**: Don't be sorry. Be angry. It lasts longer. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:75</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[entry points opened directly from elsewhere, or reached only from them:]*

*[again: opened directly from rooms/chandlery.adv:96]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-again"></a>`again` **HOBB**: The band won't move. The crowbar's on the counter, if you're helping. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:31</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: I'm helping. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:32</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [hand](#dlg-hobb-hand) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: I'll come back. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:33</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[joined: opened directly from rooms/chandlery.adv:93]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-joined"></a>`joined` **HOBB**: She'll hold. I'm coming with her. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:35</sub>
- *[sets met_hobb]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:36</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Your brother? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:37</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [brother](#dlg-hobb-brother)
- **2.** **FENN**: Welcome aboard. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:38</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-brother"></a>`brother` **HOBB**: Tam. He went into the fog three months back. I want him back. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:40</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: We'll find him. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:41</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [promise](#dlg-hobb-promise)
- **2.** **FENN**: I'm sorry. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:42</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [sorry](#dlg-hobb-sorry)

<a id="dlg-hobb-promise"></a>`promise` **HOBB**: Aye. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:44</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-sorry"></a>`sorry` **HOBB**: Don't be. Be useful. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:47</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[after: opened directly from rooms/chandlery.adv:90]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-after"></a>`after` **HOBB**: The mast will hold. I'll be at the Marrow. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:50</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Your brother? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:51</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [brother](#dlg-hobb-brother) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Right. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:52</sub>
  - *[ends]*

*[hold_after: opened directly from rooms/below_decks.adv:96]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-hold_after"></a>`hold_after` **HOBB**: Forty-one barrels. I will know if one goes missing. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:78</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Who do we tell? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:79</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [tell2](#dlg-hobb-tell2)
- **2.** **FENN**: Good. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:80</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-tell2"></a>`tell2` **HOBB**: The crew. All of it. He can't sell cargo we have all seen. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:82</sub>
- *[ends]*

*[bell: opened directly from rooms/reef_wreck.adv:120]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-bell"></a>`bell` **HOBB**: You heard it. Three, then one. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:88</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bell2](#dlg-hobb-bell2)

<a id="dlg-hobb-bell2"></a>`bell2` **FENN (V.O.)**: Across the flats, the bell again. Three notes, then one. It does not hurry. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:91</sub>
- *→ continues at* [bell3](#dlg-hobb-bell3)

<a id="dlg-hobb-bell3"></a>`bell3` **HOBB**: That is Tam. That is my brother's hand on the rope. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:94</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: How do you know? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:95</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [know](#dlg-hobb-know)
- **2.** **FENN**: Tam is alive, then. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:96</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [alive](#dlg-hobb-alive)
- **3.** **FENN**: It could be the wind. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:97</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [wind](#dlg-hobb-wind)

<a id="dlg-hobb-know"></a>`know` **HOBB**: He rings it like he did on the Arcadia. Three to call the watch, one to send them home. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:99</sub>
- *→ continues at* [tam](#dlg-hobb-tam)

<a id="dlg-hobb-tam"></a>`tam` **HOBB**: Tam Hobb. Able seaman. Three months in the fog, and still counting the watches. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:108</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: We will bring him out. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:109</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [promise3](#dlg-hobb-promise3)
- **2.** **FENN**: Who rings for the others? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:110</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [others](#dlg-hobb-others)

<a id="dlg-hobb-promise3"></a>`promise3` **HOBB**: Aye. When we board her, I go to the bell first. You find your father. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:112</sub>
- *→ continues at* [plate](#dlg-hobb-plate)

<a id="dlg-hobb-plate"></a>`plate` **FENN (V.O.)**: Hobb works a broken bow timber out of the deck. It does not belong to this ship. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:118</sub>
- *→ continues at* [plate2](#dlg-hobb-plate2)

<a id="dlg-hobb-plate2"></a>`plate2` **HOBB**: M. Mordant. Master. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:121</sub>
- *[Fenn receives: Mordant's nameplate]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:122</sub>
- *[chart:* M. MORDANT, MASTER, on a brass plate from the Grey Lantern's bow.*]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:123</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: The Grey Lantern's bow. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:124</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [bow](#dlg-hobb-bow)
- **2.** **FENN**: Who is Mordant? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:125</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [mordant](#dlg-hobb-mordant)
- **3.** **FENN**: Then we have a name. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:126</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [name2](#dlg-hobb-name2)

<a id="dlg-hobb-bow"></a>`bow` **HOBB**: Aye. Grey paint under the salt. The old ship has been shedding pieces for eighty years. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:128</sub>
- *→ continues at* [plan](#dlg-hobb-plan)

<a id="dlg-hobb-plan"></a>`plan` **HOBB**: When we board her, I go to the bell. I cut it loose before the rest of you are aboard. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:137</sub>
- *[sets bell_plan]* <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:138</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: And the name? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:139</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [plan_name](#dlg-hobb-plan_name)
- **2.** **FENN**: Why did you come? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:140</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why3](#dlg-hobb-why3)
- **3.** **FENN**: We board her. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:141</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-plan_name"></a>`plan_name` **HOBB**: That is your business. I only know it is written on brass. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:143</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-why3"></a>`why3` **HOBB**: Tam went to sea because I did. He is three years younger and always one rope ahead. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:150</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: You came to bring him home. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:151</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why4](#dlg-hobb-why4)
- **2.** **FENN**: You think he is still alive. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:152</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why5](#dlg-hobb-why5)

<a id="dlg-hobb-why4"></a>`why4` **HOBB**: He would do the same for me. That is the whole of it. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:154</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-why5"></a>`why5` **HOBB**: He is ringing that bell. A dead man has no need to keep time. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:157</sub>
- *[ends]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-mordant"></a>`mordant` **HOBB**: Her master. It is the one thing the wreck held on to. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:131</sub>
- *→ continues at* [plan](#dlg-hobb-plan) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-hobb-name2"></a>`name2` **HOBB**: We have a name. What we do with it is your business. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:134</sub>
- *→ continues at* [plan](#dlg-hobb-plan) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-hobb-others"></a>`others` **HOBB**: Every lost ship has a hand on a rope. Somebody is ringing for all of them. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:115</sub>
- *→ continues at* [plate](#dlg-hobb-plate) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-hobb-alive"></a>`alive` **HOBB**: He is at his post. If he were not, the bell would be quiet. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:102</sub>
- *→ continues at* [tam](#dlg-hobb-tam) *(above)*

<a id="dlg-hobb-wind"></a>`wind` **HOBB**: The wind has never kept time. Tam does. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:105</sub>
- *→ continues at* [tam](#dlg-hobb-tam) *(above)*

*[plan_after: opened directly from rooms/reef_wreck.adv:125]*

<a id="dlg-hobb-plan_after"></a>`plan_after` **HOBB**: The bell is mine. The rest is yours. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:146</sub>
- **1.** **FENN**: Why did you come? <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:147</sub>
  - *→ continues at* [why3](#dlg-hobb-why3) *(above)*
- **2.** **FENN**: Wait for my word. <sub>dialogue/hobb.adv:148</sub>
  - *[ends]*

<a id="act1-weather_works"></a>
## The Lighthouse

*[room* `weather_works`*]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[if seen:rook.book and weather_works_store = false]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:17</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The lighthouse yard. Rook's log should be in the keeper's store, behind the brazier. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:18</sub>

**the path down to Upper Town** `path_down` <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:22</sub>

- **Look at:** The path down the hill to Upper Town. The wind comes up it, cold. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:26</sub>
- **Use / Open / Walk to:** *[→ goes to Upper Town]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:25</sub>

**the Shroud** `fog` <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:28</sub>

- **Look at:** The Shroud, lying on the water below the headland. It looks like weather. The island knows better. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:32</sub>
- **Talk to:** I say the island's name into the fog. Nothing answers, which is something. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:33</sub>

**the path to the lighthouse** `path` <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:35</sub>

- **Look at:** The path climbs the headland to the lighthouse door. Wet cobbles, and the wind coming up them. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:38</sub>
- **Use:** It goes up. It also goes down. I know which way I came. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:39</sub>

**the lighthouse** `lighthouse` <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:41</sub>

- **Look at:** The lighthouse. Stone on stone, and a lamp lit at the top of it. From the sea it must look like the only thing holding the dark up. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:44</sub>
- **Talk to:** I talk to the tower. It has heard worse from the wind. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:45</sub>
- **Use:** The door at the base is barred. The keeper is up top, where the light is. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:46</sub>

**the great lamp** `light` <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:48</sub>

- **Look at:** The great lamp, burning behind its glass. The keeper trims it twice a night, and has never once been late. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:51</sub>
- **Talk to:** I say nothing to the light. It has enough to do. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:52</sub>
- **Use:** The glass is warm from the other side. I leave it alone. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:53</sub>

**the keeper's store** `store` <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:55</sub>

- **Look at:** The keeper's store, behind the brazier. Rook's old log is on the shelf behind the brazier. Not mine to take yet. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:58</sub>
  - *[chart:* Rook's old log is in the keeper's store at the lighthouse. The last page is a list of names.*]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:59</sub>
- **Use:** I take the log down. The keeper can have it back when Rook has read it. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:60</sub>
  - *[chart:* Rook's old log is in the keeper's store at the lighthouse. The last page is a list of names.*]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:61</sub>
  - *[sets weather_works_store]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:62</sub>
- **Open:** The store door is open. I take Rook's log from the shelf. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:63</sub>
  - *[chart:* Rook's old log is in the keeper's store at the lighthouse. The last page is a list of names.*]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:64</sub>
  - *[sets weather_works_store]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:65</sub>
- *When* *[if weather_works_store]* <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:66</sub>
  - **Look at:** The shelf where Rook's log sat is empty. The keeper will have questions. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:67</sub>
  - **Use:** I have what I need. The keeper can keep the shelf. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:68</sub>
  - **Open:** I have what I need. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:69</sub>

**the brazier** `brazier` <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:71</sub>

- **Look at:** The brazier at the keeper's door, heaped with kelp. It throws more smoke than light. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:74</sub>
- **Use:** I'd only add to the smoke. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:75</sub>
- **Pick up:** Absolutely not. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:77</sub>
- **Turn off:** There's no lid and no switch. The sea is a long walk down. <sub>rooms/weather_works.adv:76</sub>

<a id="act1-pier_end"></a>
## The Harbour Mouth

*[room* `pier_end`*]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act I, if vex_deal and dorrit_cleared and quill_compass and seen:quill.join and rook_story and hobb_joined and pier_ready = false]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:22</sub>
  - *[sets pier_ready]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:23</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Vex is at the lamp with his coat buttoned to the throat. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:24</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The harbour is quiet. Even the gulls have gone to bed. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:25</sub>

**Captain Vex** `vex` *[present Act I, if vex_deal and dorrit_cleared and quill_compass and seen:quill.join and rook_story and hobb_joined]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:29</sub>

- **Look at:** Captain Vex, at the lamp, dressed for a portrait and a fight. He is watching the fog, not me. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:33</sub>
- **Talk to:** Captain. The crew is ready, and the rudder is on. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:34</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Vex turns from the fog. For once he does not look pleased with himself. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:35</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: "Then we go," he says. "Before I remember why I do not." <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:36</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: He walks down to the boat without looking back at the island. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:37</sub>
  - *[→ Act I ends]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:38</sub>
- **Give:** He looks at my hands. "Keep it. I have been paid enough for one lifetime." <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:39</sub>

**the Marrow's boat** `boat` <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:41</sub>

- **Look at:** The Marrow's boat, made fast under the lamp. Her sail is furled and her oars are shipped. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:44</sub>
- **Use:** I could row out to the Marrow myself. I would rather not arrive out of breath. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:46</sub>
- **Open:** I step aboard. It rocks like a boat that has been waiting. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:45</sub>
- *When* *[Act I, if vex_deal and dorrit_cleared and quill_compass and seen:quill.join and rook_story and hobb_joined]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:47</sub>
  - **Look at:** The boat is ready. Somebody has folded her sail and left the gangplank down. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:48</sub>

**back along the quay** `town` <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:50</sub>

- **Look at:** Back along the quay, the lights of Dreadwater. Half of them are out. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:54</sub>
- **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Quay]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:53</sub>
- **Open:** I walk back toward the harbour. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:55</sub>
  - *[→ goes to The Quay]* <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:53</sub>

**the lighthouse** `lighthouse` <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:57</sub>

- **Look at:** The lighthouse. It has burned every night for eighty years, and it does not reach the fog. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:60</sub>
- **Use:** I cannot climb it from here. I am not sure I would want to. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:61</sub>

**the harbour mouth** `sea` <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:63</sub>

- **Look at:** The harbour mouth. Past it the fog bank sits on the water, tall as a wall and twice as quiet. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:66</sub>
- **Talk to:** I tell the fog I am coming. It does not answer, which is worse than an answer. <sub>rooms/pier_end.adv:67</sub>

<a id="act2"></a>
# Act II: The Crew

<a id="act2-opening"></a>
## Act II — Opening

*[Fenn carries: Elias's compass, Quill's spyglass, Hobb's crowbar]* <sub>acts.adv:13</sub>

*[starts in The Marrow — Deck]*

> **CAPTION**: The Marrow is ours, for what that's worth. Vex at the helm, Quill aloft, Dorrit below, Hobb at the mast. The fog is waiting. <sub>acts.adv:14</sub>

<a id="act2-marrow_deck"></a>
## The Marrow — Deck

*[room* `marrow_deck`*]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:1</sub>

**On arrival**

- *Once,* *[Act II, if fog_tried and hatch_hinted = false]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:23</sub>
  - *[sets hatch_hinted]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:24</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The hatch cover comes up clean now. Below: the ladder, the crew deck, and the smell of other ships. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:25</sub>
- *Once,* *[Act II, if fog_tried = false and seen:vex.send = false]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:27</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: A deck built for thirty, and hardly anybody on it. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:28</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Vex is at the helm, hat down against the sun. He has not looked back at the island. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:29</sub>
- *Once,* *[Act II, if seen:vex.send and fog_tried = false and shrouds_hinted = false]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:31</sub>
  - *[sets shrouds_hinted]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:32</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Quill's office is up the rigging by the foremast. The rope ladder would take me, if my hands agreed. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:33</sub>
- *Once,* *[Act II, if fog_tried and salvage_seen = false]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:35</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The crew is on deck. The hatch is unbarred, and nobody wants to be first below. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:36</sub>
- *Once,* *[Act II, if salvage_seen and vex_exposed = false]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:38</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The deck is empty. They have all gone up to the helm. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:39</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: The captain is waiting. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:40</sub>
- *Once,* *[Act II, if vex_exposed and marrow_lost = false]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:42</sub>
  - **FENN (V.O.)**: Above us, the helm is turning. Vex is not waiting for me. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:43</sub>

**the sea** `rail` <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:45</sub>

- **Look at:** The sea, going gold at the edge. It looked bigger from the quay. Or I was smaller. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:48</sub>
- **Talk to:** I say hello to the sea. It has heard better. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:49</sub>
- **Use:** The sea has nothing to say to a clerk with a compass. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:50</sub>

**the bow deck** `forward` <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:52</sub>

- **Look at:** The bow, and the fog past it. The deck narrows there, and the fog does not. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:55</sub>
- **Open:** Vex wants us aft until he has said his piece. The bow can wait. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:56</sub>
- *When* *[Act II, if fog_tried]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:57</sub>
  - **Look at:** The bow, and the fog past it. I have heard it answer. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:59</sub>
  - **Use / Walk to:** *[→ goes to The Shroud]* <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:58</sub>
  - **Open:** I go forward again. My hands remember the rail. <sub>rooms/marrow_deck.adv:60</sub>
